items.q: What type of aircraft have you flown?
items.cn: 你飞过哪些机型？
items.a: I have flown sr20 and DA42.

items.q: How many kinds of type-ratings do you have now? What are they?
items.cn: 你现在有几种机型签注？分别是哪些？
items.a: Now I have two type-ratings. - single engine land - multi-engine land -A320/B737.

items.q: Please compare the aircraft you fly in your company and the aircraft you fly in your school?
items.cn: 请比较一下你公司的飞机和你航校的飞机。
items.a: In the flight school, I fly da42, They are the training aircraft in our initial flight training. They are easy to control. In the company, I will fly A320,They are large commercial aircraft. They are more advanced. They may improve the aircraft performance, reduce our workload and make our flight easier and safer.

items.q: What's the difference between airbus aircraft and Boeing aircraft?
items.cn: 空客飞机和波音飞机有什么区别？
items.a: There are some differences between airbus aircraft and Boeing aircraft. 1) Airbus aircraft use fly-by-wire system and Boeing aircraft use hydraulic mechanical system. 2) Airbus aircraft use side stick and Boeing aircraft use control column.

items.q: If you have the choice to choose, will you fly A320 or B737?
items.cn: 如果让你选，你会飞 A320 还是 B737？
items.a: If I have a chance to choose, I will choose A320 because airbus aircraft use side stick we will have more space, we will feel more comfortable. Besides, airbus use fly-by-wire and it can reduce our workload.

items.q: What are the technological advantages and disadvantages of the aircraft you fly now?
items.cn: 你所飞飞机有哪些 优缺点
items.a: There are some advantages and disadvantages of the aircraft I fly now. The aircraft is equipped with digital instruments.It can improve our aircraft performance, increase our situation awareness and make our flight safer and easier. there are some disadvantages of the aircraft. For example, if there is electrical failure during flight, the computers maybe out of work, it may threaten flight safety.

items.q: If you have chance to choose any type of aircraft, which type will you fly?
items.cn: 如果有机会任选机型，你会选哪种？
items.a: If I have a chance to choose, I will choose airbus because airbus aircraft use side stick and we will have more space, we will feel more comfortable. Besides, airbus use fly-by-wire and it can reduce our workload.

items.q: What is your opinion about large commercial aircraft designed and manufactured in China?
items.cn: 你对中国自主设计制造的大型商业客机怎么看
items.a: So far, there are some large commercial aircraft designed and made in China, such as ARJ-21, C919. They are equipped with advanced equipment and systems and They can make our flight safe and comfortable.We feel very proudof themand we are looking forward to flying them.

items.q: Can you say something about the new type of aircraft C919?
items.cn: 你能说说新型飞机 C919 吗
items.a: As we know, C919 is the large commercial aircraft designed and manufactured (made) in China. C stands for China, 9 stands for ever lasting, 19 means that the aircraft can take 190 persons.

items.q: What is your opinion on the new type of aircraft C919?
items.cn: 你对新机型 C919 怎么看
items.a: There are some (technological) advantages of C919 (I think C919 is good). 1) C919 is equipped with fly-by-wire system and automatic flight control systems to improve aircraft performance and passenger comfort. 2) C919 is equipped with digital flight instruments to increase situational awareness and reduce pilots'workloadand make the flight safer and easier.

items.q: If not, what flight instruments are used to display the flight information?
items.cn: 如果没有，用什么仪表显示飞行信息？
items.a: Yes, our aircraft is equipped with EFIS, Electronic Flight Instrument System. EFIS consists of PFD and MFD. PFDis used to display some important flight information such as altitude, airspeed, heading. MFD is used to display navigation information and weather information and so on. They can increase the performance of the aircraft, reduce our workload and enhance the flight safety.

items.q: Can you name some of the control surfaces?
items.cn: 你能说说飞行操纵面吗
items.a: Yes, flight control surfaces consist of primary flight control surfaces and secondary flight control surfaces. The primary flight control surfaces include ailerons, elevators and rudder. The secondary flight control surfaces includeflaps, slats, spoilers and trim tabs.

items.q: The ailerons and flaps are located on the wings of the aircraft. The elevators and rudder are located onthetail ofthe aircraft. What are the functions of those fly control surfaces?
items.cn: 这些飞行操纵面的作用是什么
items.a: The ailerons are used to control the roll. Elevators are used to control the pitch. The rudder is used to control the yaw. The flaps are used to increase the lift during takeoff and increase drag during landing.

items.q: What should you pay attention to when extending or retracting the flaps?
items.cn: 收放襟翼时，你会考虑什么
items.a: When extending or retracting the flaps, we should pay attention to - the altitude of the aircraft, - the speed of the aircraft, - the wind condition, - the runway condition and so on.

items.q: What are the standard callout for flaps' extension or retraction?
items.cn: 收放襟翼标准喊话有哪些
items.a: B737 1) PF calls "Flap 1", PM replies and checks "altitude good (check altitude below 20000 feet, speed below230knots)", PM sets flap 1. 2) PF calls "Flap 5", PM replies and check "speed below 210 knots", PM sets Flap 5. 3) PF calls "Flap 15", PM replies and check "speed below 200 knots", PM sets Flap 15. 4) PF calls "Flap 30", PM replies and check "speed below 175 knots", PM sets Flap 30. 5) PF calls "Flap 40", PM replies and check "speed below 162 knots", PM sets Flap 40 （as needed).

items.q: What may be the consequences if the flaps have been extended above altitude limitations?
items.cn: 襟翼高于高度限制放出会有什么后果
items.a: If the flaps have been extended above altitude limitations, it may trigger the master warning. Besides, it maycause structural damage to the flaps.

items.q: According to your company SOP, what is the flap setting for takeoff?
items.cn: 根据公司 SOP，起飞襟翼设置是什么样的
items.a: According to the SOP, we will set the correct flaps for takeoff based on - the performance of the aircraft, - the wind condition, - the runway conditions (length) - and so on.

items.q: What will you do if the flaps are jammed during landing?
items.cn: 着陆时襟翼被卡阻，你会怎么办
items.a: If the flaps are jammed during landing, first, we will report our situation to ATC and request the longest runway for landing. Second, we will hold to burn fuel to reduce the weight and reduce the touchdown speed.

items.q: How many hydraulic systems are there on your aircraft?
items.cn: 你飞机有多少套液压系统
items.a: I flyDA42, there is no hydraulic system. But I know there are three hydraulic systems in A320, blue system, yellow system and green system. There are \_\_\_\_\_\_ hydraulic systems in B737, System \_\_\_\_\_, System \_\_\_\_\_ and \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ system.

items.q: What are the main function of hydraulic system?
items.cn: 液压系统的主要功能是什么
items.a: Hydraulic system is mainly used to provide hydraulic powe（r pressure）to contro（l operate）aircraft units such as landing gear, flaps, brakes, steering and so on.

items.q: If one system fails, will it effect flight safety?
items.cn: 如果一套液压系统失效，会影响飞行安全吗
items.a: As I know, there are three hydraulic systems in A320orB737. If one of them fails, we can switch to other working hydraulic system. They can provide hydraulic power too, so it won't affect flight safety.

items.q: If there is hydraulic fluid leak, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果液压油泄露，你该怎么办
items.a: If there is hydraulic fluid leak before flight, we will report it to mechanics for check. If there is hydraulic fluid leak during flight, First we will report our situation to ATC and request emergency landing,Second we will follow checklist to check the aircraft units such as landing gear, flaps, brakes and steering.

items.q: What are the possible consequences of hydraulic system failure during flight?
items.cn: 飞行中液压系统失效的后果有哪些
items.a: There are some possible consequences of hydraulic system failure. For example, if the hydraulic system fails during landing, the landing gears can't be extended, we may have to makea belly landing.

items.q: What will you do if the landing gear does not extend?
items.cn: 如果起落架放不出，你如何处置
items.a: If the landing gear can not extend, I will report it to ATC and request hold for further check and try manual extensionto crank it down. If the nose gear can not extend, we can request touch and go to jar it down. If the landing gear can't be extended either, we have to make a belly landing.

items.q: Please describe the alternate gear extension system, and how does the system work?
items.cn: 请描述备用起落架收放系统，以及这个系统如何工作
items.a: The alternate gear extension system is used to extend the landing gear manually if the landing gear can't be extended hydraulically or electrically. In emergency situations, we can use the alternate gear extension system to disconnect the uplock of the landinggearand the landing gear will fall down with gravity.

items.q: How do you determine if the landing gear is down if the gear indication lights are inoperative,?
items.cn: 如果起落架指示灯失效，你如何判断起落架已放下？
items.a: If the gear indication lights are inoperative, we will request low pass for visual check if the landing gear isdown. Besides, in large aircraft, the warning system such as GPWS or radar altimeter will trigger a warning if the aircraft istoo close to the ground with the landing gear is not down. Some aircraft can give us voice warning "gear not down".

items.q: Have you encountered electrical system failure during flight?
items.cn: 你遭遇过电气失效吗
items.a: No, I have never encountered electrical system failure during flight.

items.q: How many kinds of sources of electrical power are there in the aircraft?
items.cn: 飞机上有哪些电气动力来源
items.a: There are some sources of electrical power in the aircraft such as - engine driven generator, - emergency generator, - battery and so on.

items.q: When do you need to use APU for power supply?
items.cn: 什么时候你有必要使用 APU
items.a: When we are on the ground, before engines are started, GPU is not available, we will use APU for power supply When we are in the air, if the engines fail, we will use APU for power supply.

items.q: When do you need to use external power?
items.cn: 什么时候你有必要使用外接电源
items.a: When we are on the ground, before engines are started and APU is inoperative （INOP）, we will use external power.

items.q: What kind of parameters of engine are vital to flight operations?
items.cn: 哪些发动机参数对飞行运行非常重要
items.a: There are some important engine parameters such as - N1;- N2;- EGT;- vibration.

items.q: What are the differences between piston engines and turbine engines?
items.cn: 活塞发动机和涡轮发动机有什么区别？
items.a: There are some differences between piston engines and turbine engines. 1)turbine engines use fuel and piston engines use gas 2) turbine engines are more powerful than piston engines. 3) turbine engines are more fuel efficient than piston engines. 4) turbine engines have less vibration than piston engines.

items.q: During cruise,if you notice abnormal engine parameter indication, what will you do?
items.cn: 在巡航时，如果你注意到不正常的发动机参数显示，你会怎 么办
items.a: If we notice abnormal engine parameter indications during cruise, we will follow SOP and QRH to solve the problem. for example, if the oil temperature is higher than normal, we will monitor other engine parameters. then we will report it to ATC and request emergency landing at the nearest suitable airport and emergency services.

items.q: What's your engine failure procedure during cruise?
items.cn: 巡航时，发动机失效程序是什么
items.a: If the engine fails during flight 1) we will shut down the faulty/ affected engine and reduce power to idle. 2) we will check if there is any damage to the faulty/affected engine. 3) if there is no damage to the engine, we will consider/perform engine restart. 4) we will report it to ATC and request priority landing.

items.q: What systems does your aircraft have?
items.cn: 你飞什么机型，你飞机有哪些飞机系统
items.a: I fly DA42 There are many aircraft systems in our aircraft such as electrical system, communication system, navigation system, flight control system and so on.

items.q: What may cause in-flight depressurization?
items.cn: 飞行中失压可能由哪些原因造成？
items.a: There are some possible reasons for depressurization. First, bleed air leak may cause depressurization. Second, air conditioning problems may cause depressurization. Third,structural damage such as damage to the doors or windows may cause depressurization. Besides, there are some other reasons for depressurization.

items.q: Slow depressurization or rapid depressurization?
items.cn: 快失压，慢失压，哪个更危险
items.a: I think, slow depressurization is more dangerous. It may be caused by small and slow air leak. Inthis situation, the pilots may not find it and get incapacitated.

items.q: In circumstance of rapid depressurization, what are your standard procedures?
items.cn: 快失压情况下，你们的标准程序是什么
items.a: If we encounter rapid depressurization, first, we will put on the oxygen masks. Second,we will follow SOP and QRH to solve the problem. third, seting Squawk Code 7700 fourth, we will report our situation to ATC and request emergency descent to FL100.

items.q: Have you ever encountered air conditioning system failure during flight?
items.cn: 你在飞行中遇到过空调系统故障吗
items.a: No, I have never encountered air conditioning system failure during flight.

items.q: What will you do if you encounter air conditioning system failure during flight?
items.cn: 在飞行中遇到过空调系统故障你会怎么做
items.a: If the air conditioning system fails during takeoff, we will return to land because if the air conditioning system fails, the temperature will be too high or too low and the pressurization system may be out of work, it may affect flight safety.

items.q: Will you return for landing or continue the flight if you encounter air conditioning system failure?
items.cn: 如果你遇到空调系统故障，你会返回着陆还是继续飞行
items.a: If we encounter air conditioning system failure during flight, we will report our situation to ATC and request divert tothe nearest suitable airport and request maintenance on arrival.

items.q: Can you introduce the oxygen system on the aircraft?
items.cn: 你能介绍下飞机上的氧气系统吗
items.a: The oxygen system is used to provide oxygen to persons on board in case of emergency. As I know there are two oxygen systems: one for flight crew and the other for cabin crew and passengers.

items.q: Under what circumstances, will pilots use oxygen masks?
items.cn: 在什么情况下飞行员会使用氧气面罩
items.a: First, if there is depressurization,such as windshield is cracked or structural damage we will use oxygen masks. Second, if there is smoke or fire in the cockpit, we will use oxygen masks.

items.q: Where do you get these information?
items.cn: 你从哪里获得这些信息？
items.a: Yes, our company provides some guidelines for handling two-way communication failure. We can get these information from EFB or airport details.

items.q: What would you do if your receiver, transmitter or transceiver fails?
items.cn: 如果接收机或发射机或接收发射一体机失效，你该怎么办
items.a: If we encounter receiver failure, we will squawk 7600 and we can transmit blind on the frequency. If we encounter transmitter failure, we will squawk 7600, and we can squawk ident or make turns to show we can receive the transmissions. If we encounter two-way communication failure, we will squawk 7600. And we should follow the last ATC instructionsor follow the flight planned route.

items.q: What human factors will affect good communication?
items.cn: 哪些人为因素会影响良好通讯
items.a: There are some human factors that may affect good communication. First, if controllers or pilots don't use standard words, it may affect good communication. Second, high pilot workload may affect good communication. Third, wrong frequency setting may affect good communication.

items.q: What environmental factors will affect effective communication?
items.cn: 哪些环境因素会影响有效通讯
items.a: There are some environmental factors that may affect effective communication. First, lightning strike may affect effective communication because lightning strike may cause damage to the aircraft and cause communication failure. Second, loud back ground noise may affect effective communication.

items.q: What communication skills will affect smooth communication between pilots and controllers?
items.cn: 哪些通讯技巧会影响飞行员和管制员顺畅通讯
items.a: First, if we don't speak loudly and clearly, it may affect smooth communication. Second, if we don't use standard words, it may affect smooth communication. Third, poor English may affect smooth communication. In flight operation, which crew member is responsible for air-to-ground radiotelephony (RTF) communication with ATC.

items.q: What factors may affect effective communication between ATC and pilots?
items.cn: 哪些因素会影响飞行员和管制员的有效通讯
items.a: There are many factors that may affect effective communication between pilots and controllers. First, the radio equipment may affect effective communication between pilots and ATC. For example, if there is radio failure such as transmitter failure or receiver failure or two-way failure, it may cause communication failure. Second, human factors may affect effective communication between pilots and ATC. For example, if the pilotsor controllers don't use standard words and phrases, it may cause misunderstanding or miscommunication.

items.q: In your opinion, what could pilots do to improve the quality of radio communication?
items.cn: 你认为，飞行员可以做些什么提高和管制员的通信质量
items.a: There are many things we can do/ to improve the communication between pilots and controllers, first, we should check the radios to ensure they are working properly/well. Second, we should follow the communication procedure and use standard words to avoid misunderstanding betweenpilots and controllers. Third, we should speak loudly and clearly.

items.q: What are some of the ways to communicate with ATC and flight?
items.cn: 与管制和机组联络的方式有哪些？
items.a: There are two ways to communicate with ATC.

items.q: Have you ever had radio failure during flight?
items.cn: 你遭遇过无线电失效吗
items.a: No, I have never encountered radio failure during flight.

items.q: If yes, please say it; If no, have you ever heard any accidents caused by misunderstanding?
items.cn: 你遭遇过飞行员和管制员相互 误解吗
items.a: No, I have never encountered misunderstanding between pilots and controllers. But I have heard some accidents caused by misunderstanding between pilots and controllers. For example, once, the controller instructed the pilot to "descend two four zero zero feet", which means "descendtwo thousand four hundred feet", but the pilot misunderstood it as "descend to four hundred feet".

items.q: As a result, the aircraft crashed into the hill Are there any efficient ways to avoid misunder standing between pilots and controllers?
items.cn: 有没有什么有效办法可以避免飞行员和 管制员误解
items.a: Yes, there are some efficient ways to avoid misunderstanding between pilots and controllers. first, we can check the radios to ensure they are working well. Second, we should follow the communication procedure and use standard words to avoid misunderstanding betweenpilots and controllers. Third, if we have some doubt about ATC instructions, we should confirm it with ATC immediately. Fourth, we should improve our English proficiency.

items.q: What does CPDLC stand for?
items.cn: CPDLC 代表什么？
items.a: CPDLC stands for Controller Pilot Data Link Communication.

items.q: When the two-way radio communication failure occurs, how will you operate CPDLC to follow ATC instructions?
items.cn: 如果发生双向无线电通讯失效，你如何操作 CPDLC 执行管 制指令
items.a: When we encounter the two-way radio communication failure during flight, first, we will squawk 7600. Second, we will follow the last ATC instructions. Third, we will use CPDLC to tell the controller that we have two-way communication failure and request revert to CDPLC. fourth, we will acknowlege ATC instructions and send them back to follow ATC instructions.

items.q: If your captain or first officer is incapacitated in flight, will you make a PA?
items.cn: 如果机长或副驾飞行中失能，你会做乘客广播吗
items.a: If the captain or first officer is incapacitated in flight, we won't make a PA because it may make the passengers inthe cabin panic and out of control.

items.q: How will you tell cabin crew in this situation?
items.cn: 在这种情况下，你如何告诉空乘
items.a: If the captain or first officer is incapacitated in flight, I will keep the control of the aircraft and use the interphone totell the cabin crew to offer first aid to him or her. Then I will report our situation to ATC and request land at the nearest suitable airport and medical services upon arrival.

items.q: What does GNSS stand for?
items.cn: GNSS 是什么
items.a: GNSS stands for Global Navigation Satellite System.

items.q: What are included in GNSS?
items.cn: GNSS 包含了什么
items.a: GNSS includes GPS (Global Positioning System) in USA, GLONASS (Global Navigation Satellite System) in Russia Beidou Navigation System in China and some other satellite System.

items.q: How much do you know about GPS?
items.cn: 你对 GPS 了解多少
items.a: As I know, GPS is Global Positioning System. It is one of the（the most widely used）global navigation satellite systems （GNSS）.

items.q: What is RNP approach?
items.cn: 什么是 RNP 进近
items.a: RNP stands for Required Navigation Performance. There are two types of RNP approaches: RNP approach and RNP AR approach. Both approaches are similar toRNAV approach, however, RNP approach with the use of various sensors and equipment, achieves far greater accuracythrough the use of performance based navigation (PBN) and can therefore be flown to a DA rather than a MDA.

items.q: What are the advantages of RNP approach compared with other types of approach?
items.cn: 和其他进近方式相比，RNP 进近有哪些优势
items.a: There are many advantages of RNP approach compared with other types of approach. First, the aircraft canmaintaina constant angle or CDFA until reaching minima. This has positive benefits to fuel saving, engine life, passenger comfort and situational awareness. Second, it can reduce the flight crew stress. Third, it can minimize the risk of CFIT.

items.q: Why is RNP approach more and more popular?
items.cn: 为什么 RNP 进近越来越受欢迎
items.a: RNP approach is more and more popular. On the one hand, RNP approach can provide lateral navigation (LNAV); Onthe other hand, RNP approach can provide vertical navigation (LNAV). Besides, RNP approach can be usedintheairports with complicated terrains.

items.q: What are the significant difference between RNAV and RNP?
items.cn: RNAV 和 RNP 的明显区别是什么
items.a: There is a significant difference between RNAV and RNP. RNP is equipped with OPMA equipment while RNAV is not equipped with OPMA equipment.

items.q: What are the advantages of modern satellite navigation?
items.cn: 现代卫星导航有何优势
items.a: There are some advantages of modern satellite navigation. 1) It can provide precision guidance to the aircraft all over the world. 2) It can provide precision guidance to the aircraft in all weather conditions. 3) It is more accurate than conventional navigation. 4) It is more reliable than conventional navigation.

items.q: During flight, what navigational aids do you usually use?
items.cn: 飞行运行中，你们经常使用哪些助航设施
items.a: During flight, we often use VOR, NDB, ILS and GPS.

items.q: What will you do if you get lost in flight?
items.cn: 飞行中迷航，你该怎么办
items.a: If we get lost in flight, we will fly with basic navigation system, then we will report our situation to ATCandrequest radar vectors.

items.q: If possible, we will check the landmarks. What are the advantages of flying ILS approach, compared with VOR approach?
items.cn: 相比 VOR，ILS 有何优势
items.a: VOR approach is non-precision approach and it can provide only the lateral guidance while ILS approach is precision approach and it can provide both lateral guidance and vertical guidance.

items.q: What will you do if your onboard navigational equipment fails during flight?
items.cn: 如果机载导航电脑失效，你该怎么办
items.a: If our onboard navigation equipment has failed during flight, we will fly with basic navigation system, then wewill report our situation to ATC and request radar vectors. If possible, we will check the landmarks.

items.q: What modern navigation equipment should be integrated/ˈɪntɪɡ reɪtɪd/ into the cockpit in the future?
items.cn: 哪些导肮设备应该被集成到现代驾驶舱
items.a: I think many navigation equipment may be installed in future cockpit such as Beidou Navigation, GPS, RNP (required navigation performance), RNAV (regional navigation).

items.q: Under what circumstances, will pilots use oxygen masks?
items.cn: 什么情况下飞行员会使用氧气面罩
items.a: First, if there is depressurization, we will use oxygen masks. Second, if there is smoke or fumes in the cockpit, we will use oxygen masks.

items.q: If there is strange smell in the cockpit, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果驾驶舱有异味，你改怎么办
items.a: If there is strange smell in the cockpit, first, we will put on the oxygen masks and find the source of unusual smell. Second, we will report it to ATC and request emergency landing at the nearest suitable airport and request emergency services after landing such as fire services and medical services.

items.q: Why are pilots required to be familiar with emergency equipment?
items.cn: 飞行为什么要熟悉紧急设备
items.a: We are required to be familiar with the emergency equipment because they can be used in emergency situations to ensure flight safety. For example, if we encounter cabin fire, we can use fire extinguishers to extinguish fire. If we encounter depressurization, we can put on oxygen masks to avoid crew incapacitation.

items.q: How many portable fire extinguishers are there on your aircraft?
items.cn: 你的飞机上有多少个便携式灭火器
items.a: I fly\_\_\_\_\_\_. There are \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ portable fire extinguishers.

items.q: Under what circumstances, will you use fire extinguishers?
items.cn: 在什么情况下你会使用灭火器
items.a: There are some situations we will discharge the fire extinguishers in flight. First, if there is cabin fire, we will discharge the fire extinguishers. Second, if there is fire in the cockpit, we will discharge the fire extinguishers. Third, if there is engine fire, we will discharge the fire extinguishers.

items.q: I fly\_\_\_\_\_\_, there are \_\_\_\_\_\_\_ evacuation slides in our aircraft. What are the locations of these slides?
items.cn: 他们位于哪里
items.a: As I know, there are six evacuation slides in B737.

items.q: Are in the front, two are in the middle and two are in the tail of the aircraft. Thirteen What can evacuation slides be used for?
items.cn: 撤离滑梯的用途是什么
items.a: The emergency slides are used to help the persons on board to leave the aircraft as soon as possible in emergency situations such as bomb on board, fire on board.

items.q: Have you ever heard evacuation slides being deployed during ground operation?
items.cn: 你听说过撤离滑梯在地面运行时被放出的吗
items.a: Yes. Once, it happened to West China Airline. When the aircraft was still taxiing on the taxiway, one passenger opened the emergency exit and the emergency slide was deployed.

items.q: Is it possible that the paper manuals will be replaced by the electronic manuals filed in the on board computer?
items.cn: 纸质手册可能被储存在机载电脑里的文件所取代吗
items.a: I don't think the paper manuals will be replaced by the electronic manuals. because paper manuals canbeusedatany time, even in case of electrical failure. That is to say if there is electrical failure, the electronic manuals will be out of work.

items.q: The paper manuals or the electronic files?
items.cn: 纸质手册和电子手册，你更喜欢哪一个
items.a: I prefer to read electronic manuals because it's easy for us to find what we want and it can save some space/roomfor pilots.

items.q: Do you think QRH is useful?
items.cn: 你认为 QRH 有用吗
items.a: Yes, I think QRH is useful. If we encountered emergency situation, we can follow the checklists and procedures inQRH. It can increase our situation awareness, reduce our workload, reduce human errors to ensure flight safety.

items.q: We can get the loading sheet from the flight dispatchers. Which department is responsible for the provision of loading sheet?
items.cn: 哪个部门负责提供舱单
items.a: The dispatching office is responsible for providing the loading sheet.

items.q: Have you ever heard of interactive QRH?

Boeing Interactive Quick Reference Handbook (IQRH) is the mobile version of the paper QRH, providing increased efficiency to Boeing airplane operators that have FCOM/QRH data subscriptions.

items.q: Do you often use EFB in daily flight operations?
items.cn: 你经常在飞行运行中使用 EFB 吗
items.a: Yes, we often use EFB (Electronic Flight Bag/Bank) in flight operations. We can get some important informationfromEFB to ensure the safety and efficiency of the flight.

items.q: What does FCTM stand for?
items.cn: FCTM 代表什么
items.a: FCTM stands for Flight Crew Training Manual.

items.q: When do you use FCTM?
items.cn: 你们什么时候使用 FCTM
items.a: We often use FCTM when we have ground training or when we have simulator training.

items.q: Who is responsible for filling in the flight logbook?
items.cn: 谁负责填写飞行记录本
items.a: According to the SOP, the pilot monitoring (PM) is (normally) responsible for filling in the flight logbook.

items.q: Are there any requirements when filling in the flight logbook?
items.cn: 填写飞行记录本有要求吗
items.a: According to the SOP, the flight logbook should be filled in during cruise or after landing (with engines shutdownand parking brakes set). During ground movement or during flight level change, the flight crew shouldn't fill in the flight logbook. Besides, the flight logbook should be clear and correct.

items.q: When should flight crew check it?
items.cn: 飞行人员什么时候检查维修日志
items.a: During preflight cockpit system check, the flight crew will check the maintance logbook.

items.q: There are many adverse weather conditions that can affect flight safety, such as wind shear, lightning strike, turbulence, iceing, etc. In you opinion, what kind of weather conditions is most dangerous to flying?
items.cn: 你认为，在哪种天气下飞行最危险
items.a: I think low level wind shear is the most dangerous. Low altitude wind shear can cause the aircraft Lost altitude andit is difficult for the aircraft to clear obstacles such as terrain or buildings because our aircraft is too close to the ground.

items.q: Do you have any suggestions to reduce the accidents caused by bad weather conditions?
items.cn: 为了减少天气导致的飞行事故，你有何建议
items.a: Yes, there are many things we can do to reduce the accidents caused by bad weather conditions. First, we can get weather information before flight and discuss the weather information in the briefing room. Second, during flight, we can use weather radar or request radar vectors to avoid bad weather conditions.

items.q: What is wind shear?
items.cn: 风切变是什么
items.a: Wind shear is one of the most dangerous weather conditions. Wind shear is a sudden, rapid change in windspeedand direction.

items.q: How do you know you have encountered wind shear?
items.cn: 你怎么判断你是否遭遇了风切变
items.a: There are many ways we know we have encountered wind shear. Firstly, if there is a "wind shear" warning, we have encountered wind shear; Secondly, if there is an unacceptable level deviation in the flight, we encounter wind shear.

items.q: Where is it most likely to occur?
items.cn: 风切变最可能发生在哪里？
items.a: Wind shear is most likely to occur at seaside airports and plateau airports.

items.q: What effects might wind shear bring to your aircraft performance?
items.cn: 风切变会对飞机性能造成什么影响？
items.a: Wind shear can effect aircraft performance. Firstly, wind shear may cause airspeed increase or decrease Secondly, wind shear may cause the aircraft lose altitude.

items.q: If you hear "go around, wind shear ahead"during approach, how can you perform the wind shear recovery maneuver?
items.cn: 如果在进近时，你听见“复飞，风切变”警告，你如何执行 风切变改出程序
items.a: If we got wind shear warning during landing, we should go around immediately. If we got wind shear warning during takeoff, we would keep the control of the aircraft and add power to leavewindshear area.

items.q: If you hear "wind shear warning"during takeoff roll before V1, what will you do?
items.cn: 起飞滑跑时，V1 前，如果你听见“风切变”警告，你会怎 么办
items.a: If we hear a "wind shear" warning during take-off before V1, we will abort takeoff.

items.q: In this situation, we will reduce power to idle and use the maximum brakes If you are approaching the rotation speed, but wind shear is encountered in the airspeed suddenly decreases, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果你接近抬轮速度，遭遇到风切变，空速突然下降，你会 怎么办
items.a: If we approaching the rotation speed,but encounter wind shear, and the airspeed suddenly decreases, we'll continue to take off, use maximum thrust, and leave the wind shear area.

items.q: Does your plane provide wind shear warning to pilots?
items.cn: 你飞机提供风切变警告吗
items.a: I fly DA42 there is no wind shear warning system. (But I know there is wind shear warning system in large aircraft suchas A320 or B737). If there is wind shear ahead, we can hear he warning sound, "wind shear, wind shear".

items.q: Why is wind shear a threat to flight safety?
items.cn: 为什么风切变会危及飞行安全
items.a: Wind shear is dangerous to flight safety. First, it may cause the airspeed increased and decreased. Second, it may cause the aircraft to lose altitude, so the aircraft is difficult to control.

items.q: What would be the possible consequences if the wind shear warning was ignored by pilots?
items.cn: 如果风切变警告被飞行员忽略，会有什么后果/影响
items.a: If wind shear warnings were ignored by pilots, it is very dangerous. t may cause the airspeed increase and decrease The aircraft may lose control and crash onto the ground.

items.q: What are your suggestions on how to reduce the accidents caused by wind shear?
items.cn: 对减少风切变导致的事故，你的建议有哪些
items.a: There are many things we can do to reduce accidents caused by wind shear. First, we can get wind shear warnings from other pilot reports, controller or our wind shear warning system. Second, if there is a wind shear warning before V1, we will abort takeoff, after V1, we will control the aircraft and use maximum power (TOGA) to leave the wind shear area; Third, if we land with a wind shear warning, we will go around immediately.

items.q: If there is a passenger injure due to turbulence, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果有乘客因为颠簸受伤，你将怎么处置
items.a: If the passengers get injured due turbulence, first, we will ask the flight attendants to offer first aid. Second, we will make a PA to find if there is a doctor on board. Third, we will report our situation to ATC and request land at nearest suitable airport and medical services.

items.q: Is wake turbulence dangerous to flight safety? Why?
items.cn: 尾流对飞行安全有危险吗
items.a: The aircraft will be difficult to control. 3) The aircraft may lose control and crash onto the ground.

items.q: When you expect to encounter wake turbulence, how would you deal with the situation,?
items.cn: 预计会遇到尾流颠簸时，你如何处置？
items.a: When we expect to encounter wake turbulence, We can follow ATC instructions to keep enough separation with the preceding aircraft to avoid wake turbulence from the preceding aircraft. 2) If we encounter wake turbulence, we will (try to) keep the control of the aircraft and request change the flight pathto avoid the wake turbulence. (maneuver)

items.q: If yes, please say something about it; if no, how do you know you are in icing condition?
items.cn: 驾驶舱里飞机机体结冰(airframe icing)的显示(indications)有 哪些
items.a: As I know, there is no indication of icing conditions in the cockpit. But we can check the windshield or wings. If there is ice on the windshield or wings, we are in icing condition. Besides, if icing occurs, the airspeed may be reduced and rate of climb may be reduced.

items.q: Have you ever encountered icing conditions during flight?
items.cn: 飞行中你遭遇过结冰吗
items.a: No, I have never encountered in-flight icing. But I know in-flight icing is dangerous, so we should avoid icing conditions during flight.

items.q: If there is ice accumulates on wings, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果机翼结冰，你如何处置
items.a: If ice accumulates (builds up) on wings, we will report the situation to ATC and request change the altitude to leave the icing areas. Then we will turn on the de-icing and anti-icing system.

items.q: What should you pay attention to if there is high crosswind during landing?
items.cn: 如果着陆时有侧风，你要注意什么
items.a: If there is high crosswind during landing, we should contact ATC and request wind check. If the crosswindexceedsour limit, we will go around immediately and hold for weather improvement.

items.q: If there is strong crosswind at your destination airport, what should you be more careful about?
items.cn: 如果目的地机场有侧风，你应该注意什么
items.a: If there is strong crosswind at our destination airport, we should be more careful about wind information and our aircraft performance. If the crosswind exceeds our performance limit, we will hold for weather improvement until crosswind within our limit.

items.q: If the crosswind exceeds your limit, but your captain/first officer insists in landing, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果侧风超限，机长坚持落地，你该怎么办
items.a: If I encounter this situation, I will check the wind limit, and suggest him to go around, because it is dangerous to land with strong cross wind.

items.q: If the previous aircraft goes around due to crosswind, what will you do?
items.cn: 前机因为侧风复飞，你会怎么办
items.a: If the previous aircraft goes around due to crosswind, we will contact ATC and request wind check.

items.q: If crosswind is marginal around your standard, what will you do?
items.cn: 侧风处于标准边缘，你会怎么办
items.a: If the cross wind is marginal, we will think about the aircraft performance, visibility and the runway condition. But I think the best way is to go around and hold for weather improvement.

items.q: In heavy fog,if you miss the correct taxiway, what will you do?
items.cn: 大雾中，如果错误正确滑行道，你该怎么办
items.a: If we miss the correct taxiway, we will hold position, then we will report our situation to ATC and request further instructions. If necessary, we may request a follow-me car.

items.q: In you opinion, how can pilots reduce the risk of collisions in heavy fog?
items.cn: 你认为，大雾天气中如果避免相撞
items.a: We can do many things to avoid ground collisions in low visibility. First, we should taxi slower and taxi with caution in low visibility. Second, we should follow ATC instructions and have good situation awareness. If necessary, we may request a follow me car.

items.q: Where do pilots obtain RVR before departure?
items.cn: 起飞前飞行员从哪里获取 RVR
items.a: We can get RVR information from ATIS. 2）we can get RVR from NOTAM. 3) we can get RVR from EFB.

items.q: We can confirm RVR with ATC. Does your company operate low visibility takeoff?
items.cn: 你公司运行低能见度起飞吗
items.a: As I know, our company doesn't operate low visibility takeoff. If the visibility is below our company limit/minima, wewill delay takeoff and hold for weather improvement.

items.q: When are low visibility procedures required?
items.cn: 什么时候需要低能见度程序
items.a: According to the regulations, if the visibility is below the minimum standard for airport operation, a lowvisibility procedure is required. In this case, the controller will inform the pilot that low visibility procedures are being implemented. Twenty-one

items.q: Have you ever flown into CB or thunderstorms?
items.cn: 你遭遇过 CB 吗
items.a: No. I have never flown into CBs or thunderstorms. But I know CBs or thunderstorms are dangerous.

items.q: What damages might CBs bring to the aircraft?
items.cn: CB 会给飞机带来哪些危害
items.a: CB is dangerous because CB often goes with lightning, heavy rain, strong wind and severe turbulence. 1）Lightning strike may cause structural damage to the aircraft, especially the electronic equipment. 2）Heavy rain may cause low visibility or engine flameout. 3）Strong wind and severe turbulence may cause the aircraft difficult to control.

items.q: How do pilots search for CBs during flight?
items.cn: 飞行员怎么搜索 CB
items.a: First, we can search for the CB with weather radar. The CBs are displayed on the MFD in purple color, red color, oryellow color. Second, we can get weather information about CB from ATC or other pilot reports.

items.q: The development of thunderstorm requires three conditions: unstable atmosphere, sufficient shock force, andfull of water steam What are the three stages of thunderstorm?
items.cn: 雷暴有哪三个阶段
items.a: Thunderstorms have three stages: accumulation stage, maturity stage, and disappear stage.

items.q: How do pilots go around the thunderstorm during flight?
items.cn: 飞行中飞行员如何绕飞雷暴
items.a: If the weather radar shows a thunderstorm, we will request change heading to avoid the thunderstorm, andwecanalso request radar vectors to avoid the thunderstorm.

items.q: Have you ever encountered lightning strike during flight?
items.cn: 你在 飞行中遭遇过雷击吗
items.a: No, I have never encountered lightning strike during flight.

items.q: But I know lightning strike is dangerous, so we should avoid lightning strike during flight Do you think lightning strike dangerous to flight safety?
items.cn: 你认为雷击对飞行安全有危害吗
items.a: Structural damage （electronic equipment, fuselage, wings, wind shield) 2) electrical failure 3) digital flight instrument failure, communication failure, navigation failure Lightning strike is dangerous to flight safety. First, it may cause structural damage to aircraft such as fuselage, wings and electronic equipment. Second, it may cause electrical failure. Third, it may cause communication and navigation failure.

items.q: Under what weather conditions does lightning strike most likely occur?
items.cn: 雷击最容易在哪些天气下发生
items.a: Lightning strike is most likely to occur/happen in CBs or thunderstorms.

items.q: Two If your aircraft encounters lightning strike during flight, what will you do?
items.cn: 你如何避免雷击
items.a: Change the route 2) check the aircraft (structural damdage) 3) when clear of lightning, resume flight planned route If we encounter lightning strike, first, we will report our situation to ATC and request change the course/route to avoid lightning strike. second, we will check if there is any structural damage on board. If there is any damage to the aircraft, we will request emergency landing and emergency services. If there is no damage to the aircraft, we will continue our flight.

items.q: How can you avoid lightning strike?
items.cn: 你如何避免雷击
items.a: There are many things we can do to avoid lightning strike. First, we can get the weather information before flight and during flight to avoid flying into CB or thunderstorm. Second, if we encounter lightning strikeahead, during flight, we will change the route/course to avoid the lightning strike.

items.q: Are there any complicated airports operated by your company?
items.cn: 你公司有运行复杂机场吗
items.a: I work for Colorful Guizhou Airlines There are many complicated airports operated by our company such as high-elevation airports and seaside airports andso on.

items.q: What kind of airports can be defined as complicated airports (be defined as)?
items.cn: 什么样的机场可以称为复杂机场？
items.a: I think many airports can be considered as complicated airports. First, if the airports have more complicated runways and taxiways, they can be considered as complicated airports. Second, if the airports have more complicated weather conditions and more complicated terrains, they can be considered as complicated airports.

items.q: When flying to complicated airports, what should the flight crew be careful about?
items.cn: 飞复杂机场时，飞行人员应该注意(be careful about)什么
items.a: When we fly to complicated airports first, we should be careful about the complicated terrains such as the mountains. second, we should be careful about the complicated weather conditions such as strong crosswind, turbulence andwind shear.

items.q: What's the use of EGPWS when flying into complicated airports?
items.cn: 在复杂机场飞行时，EGPWS 有什么作用？
items.a: E)GPWS is (Enhanced) Ground Proximity Warning System. It is used to avoid the surrounding terrain. If the aircraft is too low to the terrain, we can hear warning sounds, "toolow, terrain", "terrain, pull up", "too low, gear".

items.q: When your destination airport is the high elevation airport, what preparation will you make before takeoff?
items.cn: 那你目的地机场时高 原机场，起飞前你应该做哪些准备
items.a: When our destination is a high elevation airport, we will make good preparations before takeoff. First, we will make a good walk around check to ensure the aircraft is in good conditions. Second, we will know the airport runway conditions, weather conditions and ground services.

items.q: If you encounter an abnormal situation at a high elevation airport, how will you handle it?
items.cn: 在高高原机场遇到不正常情况，你如何处置？
items.a: If I encounter some abnormal situation, I will try my best to control my aircraft and pay attention to the surrounding terrains.

items.q: Comparing the high elevation airports with sea level airports, are there any differences in the aircraft performance?
items.cn: 高原机场和海平面机场相比，飞机性能方面有差别吗
items.a: If the aircraft flies in the high elevation airport, the air is thinner, the aircraft engine performance will be reduced. When taking off, the aircraft needs more distance to reach VR. When landing, the aircraft also needs more distance to reduce the speed.

items.q: If you land at high elevation airport, what should you be more careful about?
items.cn: 在高原机场落地，你应该更加注意什么
items.a: If we are going to land at a high elevation airport, we should be careful about the surrounding terrains and complicated weather conditions such as wind shear or turbulence.

items.q: Does your company require specific qualification of pilots for flying high elevation airport?
items.cn: 你公司飞高原机场对飞行机组资质有特殊要求吗
items.a: Yes. According to regulation, the pilots must have high elevation training and get special high elevation airport qualification. Besides, the captain should be under 55 years old and the copilot must have more than 1200 flight hours.

items.q: What will you do if you land on an airport that you are not familiar with?
items.cn: 如果你在一个不熟悉机场降落，你会怎么做
items.a: If we fly to an unfamiliar airport, before flight, we will make good preflight preparation to get important information such as the weather condition, the runway condition, the taxiways and so on. After landing, if necessary, we will requesta follow-me car.

items.q: Does your company provide any training to pilots to familiarize with a new airport?
items.cn: 你公司给飞行员提供熟悉新机场的培训吗
items.a: Yes, our company provides some training to help pilots be familiar with new airport. First, we can have simulator flightto the new airport. Second, we will fly with experienced pilots to be familiar with the new airport.

items.q: After landing on an unfamiliar airport, and you miss the first rapid exit, what will you do?
items.cn: 在不熟悉机场落地，错过第一个快速脱离道，你会怎么办
items.a: After landing on an unfamiliar airport, if we miss the first rapid exit, we will report the situation and request further instruction.

items.q: What factors may cause the aircraft to overrun the runway after landing?
items.cn: 哪些因素会导致飞机落地后冲出跑道 (overrun the runway)
items.a: Mechanical problems: jammed flaps, brakes problem 2) bad weather: tailwind, heavy rain, ice and snow 3) human errors: overshooting, unstable approach, deviation from the glide path/slope There are many factors that may cause the aircraft to overrun the runway after landing. First, if the flaps are jammed during approach, the landing speed is higher than normal, the aircraft mayoverrunthe runway. Second, if the aircraft is above the glide slope during landing, the aircraft may overshoot the runway. Third, if there are problems with brakes or thrust reversers, it may cause the aircraft to run out of runway.

items.q: Have you ever experienced taking off or landing on the short and narrow runways?
items.cn: 你有过在短窄跑道起降的经历吗？
items.a: No, I have never experienced takeoff or landing on short and narrow runways.

items.q: What kind of runways can be considered as short and narrow runways?
items.cn: 什么样的跑道被称为短窄跑道(short and narrow runway)
items.a: Large aircraft: less than 1800m long, less than 45m wide heavy aircraft: less than 2200m long, less than 45mwide According to ICAO, if the runway is less than 45 meters wide and less than 1800 meters long for large aircraft andless than 2200 meters long for heavy aircraft, it is called short and narrow runway.

items.q: Can you tell me how to make a successful landing on the short and narrow runways?
items.cn: 你能告诉我如何在短窄跑道上成功落地
items.a: Make a successful landing- make good preflight preparation;- follow standard operating procedures; (low visibility, strong crosswind/tailwind- use precision approach and avoid overshooting There are many things we should do to make a safe landing on the short and narrow runways. First, we should make good preflight preparation to get the weather conditions about the airport andthe aircraft performance (landing performance: landing distance). Second, we should follow standard operation procedures, especially in case of strong wind, low visibility and runway contamination. Third, we should use precision approach such as ILS approach and we should avoid overshooting.

items.q: Why are certain amount of liquids are not allowed to be carried into the cabin?
items.cn: 为什么液体(liquid)不允许带进客舱
items.a: Some liquids are not allowed to be carried into the cabin. First, it is difficult to detect check if the liquids are dangerous goods or not. Second,different people may take different liquids into the cabin and mix it together to make a bomb What measures can be taken to prevent terrorist attack from There are many things we can do to prevent terrorist activity(attack) from happening.

items.q: Five happening?
items.cn: 可以采取哪些措施(measures)防止(prevent)恐怖袭击(terrorist attack/terrorism)发生
items.a: First, we can improve airport security check to prevent terrorists and dangerous goods entering the airport and aircraft. Second, both pilots and cabin crew can improve their skills to fight against the terrorists or hijackers.

items.q: Do you think the ground security check has been improved in the last decade?
items.cn: 你认为过去十年(in the last decades)机场安检加强/提高了 吗
items.a: I think the airport security check has been improved in the last decade. First, the passengers and their baggage)have been scanned/checked again and again before boarding the aircraft. Second, more advanced systems and equipment have been introduced to improve the airport security check. Third, more rules and regulations (laws) have been made to improve the airport security check. (For example, theextra lithium battery is not allowed to bring onboard).

items.q: According to the regulation, pilots should have dangerous goods training every two years. Why do pilots need to take some specific dangerous goods transportation training?
items.cn: 为什么飞行员需要参加危险品运输培训
items.a: I think pilots should have (specific) training for dangerous goods transportation because dangerous good are dangerous to flight safety and we should know how to identify the dangerous goodsandhow to handle dangerous goods leak.

items.q: If you have flammable liquid substance leak during flight, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果飞行中易燃液体物质泄露(flammable liquid substance leak)，你如何处置
items.a: If we have flammable liquid leak during flight, First, we will report the situation to ATC and request emergency landing and emergency services such as fire service sand medical services. Second, after landing, we will execute/make emergency evacuation.

items.q: What topics do you often discuss in dangerous goods transportation (training)?
items.cn: 危险品运输培训中常讨论哪些内容？
items.a: Give one or two examples.

items.q: Does your company provide any guidelines for identifying and handling dangerous goods during flight?
items.cn: 你公司提供识别和处理危险品的指导性文件 (guidelines) 吗
items.a: Yes, our company provides some guidelines guidance for identifying and handling/dealing with dangerous goods. I think it's necessary. Before each flight, we will check (the cargo manifest) if there is dangerous goods onboard. If there is dangerous goods, we will monitor the aircraft carefully to prevent/avoid dangerous goods leak. If there is dangerous goods leak, we will report it to ATC and request emergency landing at the nearest suitable airport and request emergency services.

items.q: Why do you think we need specific trainings for dangerous goods transportation?
items.cn: 你认为为什么需要专门的危险品运输培训？
items.a: I think pilots should have specific training for dangerous goods transportation because dangerous good are dangerous to flight safety and we should have some knowledge of dangerous goods transportation.

items.q: Before departure, if you have received a anonymous call says there is a suspicious luggage on board your aircraft, how will you deal with the situation?
items.cn: 离场前，你收到匿名电话说机上有疑似行李，你将如何处 理
items.a: If there is a suspicious luggage on board our aircraft, first, we will inform the cabin crew to search the cabin for the luggage. Second, we will report our situation to ATC and request bomb disposal squad and other emergency services suchas fire services and medical services. Third, we will execute emergency evacuation.

items.q: If ATC informs you that they have received an anonymous call says there is a bomb on board your aircraft, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果管制通知你，他们收到匿名电话说你飞机上有炸弹，你 如何处置
items.a: If there is a suspected bomb on board, first, we will inform the crew members to search the cabin for the suspected bomb. Second, we will report our situation to ATC and request bomb disposal squad and emergency services. Finally, we will execute emergency evacuation.

items.q: What's your company procedure concerning suspicious luggage check?
items.cn: 你们公司关于疑似行李检查的政策是什么
items.a: If there is a suspicious luggage on board our aircraft, first, we will inform the cabin crew to search the cabin for the luggage. Second, we will report our situation to ATC and request bomb disposal squad and other emergency services suchas fire services and medical services. Third, we will execute emergency evacuation.

items.q: What are your company's standard procedures of dealing with suspicious bomb on board?
items.cn: 你公司处理机上可疑炸弹的标准程序是什么？
items.a: If there is a suspected bomb on board, first, we will inform the crew members to search the cabin for the suspected bomb. Second, we will report our situation to ATC and request bomb disposal squad and emergency services. Finally, we will execute emergency evacuation.

items.q: What have you learnt from dangerous goods training?
items.cn: 你从危险品运输培训中学到了什么
items.a: We can learn many things from dangerous goods training such as the types of dangerous goods, the danger of dangerous goods, how to identify the dangerous goods, howto deal with dangerous goods during flight.

items.q: Seven Have you encountered bird strike during flight?
items.cn: 你遭遇过鸟击吗
items.a: No, I have never encountered bird strike during flight.

items.q: Before you take off from the airport, where can you get the information about bird activity?
items.cn: 从机场起飞前，你可以从哪里获取鸟类活动信息
items.a: Before we take off from the airport, we can get the information about bird activity from ATC, ATIS and other pilot reports.

items.q: How does bird strike threaten flight safety?
items.cn: 鸟类活动如何影响飞行安全
items.a: Bird strike is very dangerous to flight safety. First, bird strike may cause structural damage to the aircraft such as nose, windshields and engines. Second, bird strike may cause engine problems such as engine flameout, engine failure, engine surge （vibration）andso on.

items.q: Why is bird activity hazardous to the flight?
items.cn: 为什么鸟类活动危及飞行安全
items.a: Bird activity is dangerous to the flight. First, bird ingestion and bird strike may cause engine vibration, engine failure or engine flameout. Second, bird ingestion and bird strike may cause structural damage to the aircraft such as the nose, wind shield, engines and so on.

items.q: What might be the consequences of bird strike?
items.cn: 鸟击会有什么后果/影响
items.a: Bird strike is dangerous. First, bird strike may cause engine vibration, engine failure or engine flameout. Second, bird strike may cause structural damage to the aircraft such as the nose, wind shield, engines and so on.

items.q: What do you do after bird strike?
items.cn: 鸟击后你该怎么办
items.a: If we encounter bird strike, we will report our situation to ATC and request hold for further check. If the instruments are indicating normally, we will continue the flight. If the instruments are indicating abnormally, we will dump fuel and return for landing.

items.q: If your aircraft ingests some foreign object, will it endanger flight safety?
items.cn: 如果飞机吸入异物，会危及(endanger)飞行安全吗
items.a: If the engine encounters the foreign object ingestion, it is dangerous to flight safety. First, it may cause engine problems such as engine vibration, engine failure or engine flameout. Second, it may cause structural damage to the engine (fan blades).

items.q: At which phases of flight is foreign object ingestion most likely to occur?
items.cn: 异物吸入最可能发生在飞行的哪些阶段？
items.a: There are most likely to encounter foreign object ingestion during engine startup, during takeoff and during landing.

items.q: If your aircraft engine ingests some foreign objects during takeoff rolling, what will you do to deal with the situation?
items.cn: 如果你飞机起飞滑跑(during takeoff rolling)时吸入异物，你会 如何处置这种情况
items.a: If the engine ingests foreign objects before V1we will reject/abort takeoff and report it to the mechanics for check. after V1, we will continue takeoff and return for landing.

items.q: If bird ingestion happens to your aircraft during initial climb, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果初始爬升(during initial climb)时，你飞机发生吸鸟，你会 如何处置
items.a: If bird ingestion happens during initial climb, we will report our situation to ATC and request dump fuel and returnto land.

items.q: What do you often do in the briefing room before you board the aircraft each flight?
items.cn: 登机前你们在准备室经常做些什么
items.a: We will have safety briefing with cabin crew in the briefing room before flying. First, we will discuss our duties and responsibilities during flight. Second, we will discuss the weather information. Third, we will discuss the possible abnormal or emergency situations and procedures.

items.q: Where do you get these information or data?
items.cn: 你从哪里获得这些信息或数据？
items.a: Before departure, we should get some important information such as weather information, airport information, aircraft performance, and our flight plan and so on from our dispatching office or our EFB.

items.q: How long does your preflight preparation last?
items.cn: 你们飞行前准备持续多久
items.a: Our preflight preparation often lasts one or two hours. Sometimes it may last about one day.

items.q: Why do you think so?
items.cn: 绕机 是飞行前准备的重要部分吗
items.a: Yes. I think walk-around inspection is an important part of preflight preparation. During walk-around inspection, we will walk around the aircraft and check some important part of aircraft such as the nose, the landing gear, the engines, flight control surfaces and so on to ensure that the aircraft is in good condition.

items.q: If you find some abnormal situation during preflight cockpit system check, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果飞行前驾驶舱检查中发现不正常情况，你该怎么办
items.a: If we find some abnormal situation during preflight cockpit system check, we will follow the checklist to solve the problem. Then we will report the maintenance staff for maintenance check.

items.q: Do you have any experience of finding any abnormal situations during preflight preparation?
items.cn: 你在航前准备中发现过不正常情况吗？
items.a: No. I have never had any experience of finding any abnormal situations during preflight preparation.

items.q: Why do we need preflight briefing?
items.cn: 我们为什么需要飞行前准备会
items.a: We need a preflight briefing because it is necessary. preflight briefing can enhance communication and collaboration between flight crew and flight attendants.

items.q: Do you think preflight briefing is necessary?
items.cn: 你认为飞行前准备会有必要吗
items.a: Preflight briefing will be necessary. preflight briefing can enhance communication and collaboration between the flight crew and the flight attendant.In addition, during the preflight briefing, we can discuss some important things related to flight safety.

items.q: What are included in preflight briefing?
items.cn: 飞行前准备会包含些什么内容
items.a: During the preflight briefing, we have a safety preparation meeting with the cabin crew. First, we'll talk about the weather.

items.q: Whose responsibility is it to perform the walk-around inspection?
items.cn: 绕机检查由谁负责？
items.a: Generally speaking, the captain is responsible for walk-around inspection. Usually, the first officer will make walk-around inspection.

items.q: Which parts need to be checked during walk-around inspection?
items.cn: 绕机检查时需要检查哪些 组件
items.a: During walk-around inspection, we will check the aircraft units such as the nose, the engines, the landing gear, theflight control surfaces, pitot tubes and so on.

items.q: When you perform a walk-around inspection in extremely cold weather, is there anything you need to be more careful about?
items.cn: 极寒天气绕机检查时，有哪些需要特别注意？
items.a: When having walk-around inspection in extremely cold winter weather, we will check if there is ice on the aircraft andwe will check the pitot tubes to see if they are blocked by ice.

items.q: Have you ever hear any ground collision incidents?
items.cn: 你听说过地面相撞吗
items.a: Yes, I have heard some ground collision incidents. For example, the aircraft collided with other aircraft during pushback or during taxiing.

items.q: What damages might ground collision bring to the aircraft?
items.cn: 地面相撞会给飞机带来什么危害
items.a: Ground collision may cause structural damage to the aircraft such as fuselage, wings, engines and so on. It may cause injuries to persons on board.

items.q: Do you know ground collision?
items.cn: 你了解地面相撞吗
items.a: Yes, I know ground collision. For example, the aircraft collided with other aircraft, ground vehicles or ground equipment.

items.q: Why does ground collision sometimes happen?
items.cn: 为什么地面相撞有时会发生
items.a: There are some possible reasons for ground collisions. First, bad weather, especially poor visibility may cause ground collisions. Second, mechanical problems may cause ground collisions. For example, if brakes and steering are inoperative, the aircraft may lose control and it may cause ground collision. Third, human errors may cause ground collision. For example, there may be misunderstanding between the pilots and controllers. Besides, there are some other reasons for ground collision.

items.q: If you collide with the ground truck during taxiing, what will you do?
items.cn: 滑行时，你和地面车辆相撞，你该怎么办
items.a: If we collide with a ground truck while taxiing, we will stop the aircraft immediately, then we will report the situationto ATC and request ground services. If necessary, we will execute emergency evacuation.

items.q: In your opinions, how can you avoid ground collision incidents,?
items.cn: 你认为如何避免地面相撞事件？
items.a: First, when we are taxiing on the ground, we should be careful, especially in bad weather conditions. Second, we should follow ATC instructions and regulation strictly. Third, we should have good situation awareness.

items.q: What are the main factors that may cause runway incursion?
items.cn: 造成跑道侵入的主要因素有哪些？
items.a: There are some main factors that may cause runway incursion. First, bad weather such as heavy fog/low visibility may cause runway incursion. Second, misunderstanding between pilots and controllers may cause runway incursion. Third, poor airport management, for example, the ground vehicle enters the runway without ATC clearance, may cause Thirty-one runway incursion.

items.q: How can pilots prevent runway incursion from happening again?
items.cn: 飞行员如何避免跑道入侵发生
items.a: There are many things we can do to avoid runway incursion. First, we should follow ATC instructions. Second, if there is any doubt about ATC instructions, we should confirm it with ATC immediately. Third, we should have good situational awareness. Fourth, we should strengthen airport management.

items.q: Can you tell us how to make a rejected takeoff?
items.cn: 你能告诉我们如何中断起飞
items.a: In case of rejected takeoff, we will take immediate actions to stop the aircraft on the runway. First,We shloud announce abort takeoff Second, we wil reduce power to idle（l retard the thrust lever） and use the maximum brakes. third, keep the aircraft along the centerline of the runway forth, when we stop the aircraft we will report ATC tell about we abort takeff we will raise/extend the speedbrakes and ground spoilers; we will use maximum reverse thrust.

items.q: Meanwhile/at the same time, we will use rudder pedal tokeepthe directional control of the aircraft. What will be the possible consequences of rejecting takeoff after V1?
items.cn: V1 后中断起飞有什么后果
items.a: If we reject takeoff after V1, we may run out of overshoot the runway because the runway remainingisnot long enough to stop the aircraft on the runway.

items.q: What will you do if the warning alerts are triggered during takeoff rolling?
items.cn: 如果起飞滑跑时，主警告被触发，你该怎么办
items.a: If the warning alerts are triggered before V1, we will reject/abort takeoff. After V1, we will continue takeoff, report it to ATC and request return to land.

items.q: When is it necessary to execute in fly emergency descent?
items.cn: 什么时候有必要紧急下降
items.a: There are many conditions we will make emergency descent. First, if we encounter depressurization during flight, we will make emergency descent. Second, if there is smoke or fire onboard such as engine fire, cabin fire, we will carry out emergency descent.

items.q: What are the possible reasons for holding in the air?
items.cn: 哪些原因会导致空中等待
items.a: There are some possible reasons for holding in the air. 1) If the weather at destination is below minimum, we have to hold in the air for weather improvement. 2) If we encounter mechanical problem, we will request hold to perform the checklist(for further check). 3) If there is flow control, we have to hold in the air.

items.q: If ATC request you to hold at a significant fix, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果 ATC 要求你在 等待点等待，你应该怎么办
items.a: If ATC requested us to hold at a significant fix, we will ask ATC the holding instructions and the reason for holding. Then we will fly a given holding pattern until advised.

items.q: When you request the holding instructions from ATC, what information do you need?
items.cn: 如果你向 ATC 管制员申请特定的等待指令，你需要哪些信 息
items.a: When we request specific holding instructions from ATC, we need some important information about holding suchas holding fix (where to hold), holding altitude, inbound track, outbound time, left-hand pattern or right-hand pattern and so on.

items.q: Have you ever executed a missed approach?
items.cn: 你执行过复飞吗？
items.a: No. I have never executed a missed approach.

items.q: What may cause a missed approach?
items.cn: 哪些 会导致复飞
items.a: There are some possible reasons for missed approach. First, if the landing gear can't be extended, we have to make a missed approach. Second, if the weather is below minima, we have to make a missed approach. Third, if there is runway incursion, we have to make a missed approach.

items.q: What will you do If weather is marginal during approach?
items.cn: 如果天气处于边缘 ，你该怎么办
items.a: If the weather is marginal during approach, we will go around immediately and hold for weather improvement.

items.q: Stable unstable In what situations must you go around?
items.cn: 在哪些情况下你必须复飞
items.a: There are some situations we must go around. First, if the landing gear can't be extended, we have to go around. Second, if the weather is below minima, we have to go around. Third, if there is runway incursion, we have to go around.

items.q: Three Can you tell me the go around procedures?
items.cn: 你能给我们讲讲复飞程序吗
items.a: Yes, the go around procedures vary from airports to airports. The standard go around procedures are published in the airport approach charts. If we have to go around, we will follow the standard go around procedure sand use TOGA power to pull up the aircraft.

items.q: What will you do if you have to make ditching?
items.cn: 如果你不得不⽔上迫降，你该怎么办
items.a: If we have to make a ditching, we will report our situation to ATC and request emergency services after ditching. Thenwe will complete the ditching checklist and inform the cabin crew and passengers to make preparation forditchingsuchas wearing the life vest and follow the emergency evacuation procedures.

items.q: Upon ditching, we will follow the instructionsof rescuers to leave the aircraft as quickly as we can. If you decide to make a belly landing, what preparation should you make before landing?
items.cn: 如果你决定机腹着陆，在着陆前应该做哪些准备
items.a: If we have to make a belly landing, first, we will report our situation to ATC and request emergency landing and emergency services such as foamedrunway, fire services, medical services and so on. Second, we will hold somewhere to burn fuel to reduce the weight of aircraft, reduce the landing speed of theaircraftand reduce the risk of fire upon landing.

items.q: When is it necessary to execute emergency evacuation?
items.cn: 什么时候有必要执行紧急撤离
items.a: There are many situations in which we will execute an emergency evacuation. First, if there is fire on board such as engine fire, cabin fire, cockpit fire, we will execute emergency evacuation. Second, if there is a bomb on board, we will carry out emergency evacuation. Third, after emergency landing such as forced landing or belly landing, we will make emergency evacuation.

items.q: If you encounter abnormal situation and you decide to make emergency evacuation after landing, what preparations will you make before landing?
items.cn: 如果遭遇不正常情况，你们决定落地后紧急撤离，落地前你 们要做些什么准备
items.a: If we encounter abnormal situation and we decide to make emergency evacuation after landing, before landing, wewill make some preparations, first, we will report our situation to ATC and tell the controller we will make emergency evacuation after landing. Second, we will make a PA to inform the cabin crew and the passengers to prepare for the emergency evacuation.

items.q: What's your company procedure of emergency evacuation after landing?
items.cn: 你们公司着陆后紧急撤离的程序是什么
items.a: In emergency evacuation, first, the cabin crew will tell the passengers the route of evacuation and what they should be careful about. Second, the cabin crew will open the emergency exit and emergency slides. Third, the cabin crew will direct all passengers to leave the aircraft in order and in time. Thirty-four Fourth, the flight crew will complete emergency evacuation checklist and will be the last ones to leave the aircraft.

items.q: What are the possible causes for flow control?
items.cn: 流控的原因有哪些
items.a: There are many reasons for flow control. First, bad weather such as thunderstorm may cause flow control. Second, military activity may cause flow control. Third, VIP flight or emergency flight may cause flow control.

items.q: What can be done to reduce flow control?
items.cn: 减少流控的措施有哪些
items.a: There are many things we can do to reduce flow control. First, we can keep good communication and cooperation to reduce flow control. Second, we can use RVSM to increase airspace capacity to reduce flow control. Third, we can use more advanced ATC systems, equipment or procedures to reduce flow control.

items.q: Does flow control occur more frequently at big airports?
items.cn: 大机场发生流控更频繁吗
items.a: Yes. We are more likely to encounter flow control at big airports because there are more aircraft taking off or landingat big airports.

items.q: What are the possible causes of long delays?
items.cn: 延误的原因有哪些
items.a: There are many possible reasons for delays. First, bad weather may cause delays such as thunderstorm or poor visibility. Second, mechanical problem may cause delays. Third, flow control or VIP flight may cause delays. Fourth, military acvitivy may cause delays.

items.q: Do long delays occur more frequently at big airports?
items.cn: 长时间延误在大型机场更常见
items.a: Yes, long delays occur more often at big airports such as Beijing Capital International Airport, Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport because there are many aircraft departing and landing every day.

items.q: What do you think of airline compensating passengers after long delays?
items.cn: 你对航空公司因为长时间延误赔付乘客怎么看
items.a: It depends. If the long delays are caused by bad weather or flow control, I think the airlines shouldn't compensate the passengers. If the long delays are caused by airlines, the airlines should compensate the passengers.

items.q: Have you ever diverted in flight?
items.cn: 你备降过吗
items.a: No, I have never diverted so far.

items.q: What might be some possible reasons for diversion?
items.cn: 备降的原因有哪些
items.a: There are many possible reasons for diversion First, if the weather at the destination is below minima, we have to divert to our alternate airport. Second, if we encounter mechanical problem such as electrical failure, we have to divert to the nearest suitable airport. Third, if there is medical emergency on board, we will divert to the nearest suitable airport.

items.q: What preparations will you make before divert?
items.cn: 备降前你要做哪些准备
items.a: Before diversion, we will make some preparation for it. First, we will report our situation and intention to ATC and request divert to our alternate airport. Second, we will get the weather information and runway conditions at our alternate airport. Third, we will change our flight plan in the FMS. Fourth, we will make a PA to inform the cabin crew and passengers that we will divert to our alternate airport.

items.q: What information should flight crew know about the alternate airport before diversion,?
items.cn: 备降前机组应了解备降机场的哪些信息？
items.a: Before diversion, we should know some information about the alternate airport such as - runway conditions, - weather conditions and - ground services.

items.q: What kind of supports can ATC provide before diversion?
items.cn: 备降前，管制能给我们提供哪些帮助
items.a: If we decide to divert, the ATC can offer us the weather information, runway conditions and ground servicesatthe alternate airport.

items.q: Who do you need to contact in case of diversion?
items.cn: 备降情况下你要联系谁
items.a: If we have to divert, we will contact ATC and our company dispatchers.

items.q: If you have to make a diversion and you have different opinions with captain about the decision, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果需要备降而你与机长意见不一致，你怎么办？
items.a: If we have to make a diversion and I have different opinions with captain about the decision, I will showmy opinion sand reasons to captain. If the captain doesn't take my opinions, I have to follow captain's decision.

items.q: If there are some complaints among passengers about diversion, what will you do to comfort the passengers?
items.cn: 如果乘客抱怨备降，你该怎么办
items.a: If some passengers complain about the diversion, as a captain, first, I will make a PA to inform the passengers about the reason for diversion. Second, I will ask the cabin crew to offer the passengers more drinks to calm down the passengers.

items.q: Do you have alternate airport plan before each flight?
items.cn: 每次飞行前，你们计划备降场吗
items.a: Yes, we should plan the alternate airport before each flight because we may encounter emergency situations such as bad weather, mechanical problems or medical emergency during flight and we have to divert.

items.q: Six What are the possible reasons for flight diversion?
items.cn: 备降的原因有哪些
items.a: There are many situations in which we will divert. First, if the weather at the destination is below minima, we have to divert to our alternate airport. Second, if we encounter mechanical problem such as electrical failure, we have to divert to the nearest suitable airport. Third, if there is medical emergency on board, we will divert to the nearest suitable airport.

items.q: What factors should you consider when making the decision to divert?
items.cn: 做备降决定时，你会考虑哪些因素
items.a: There are many factors we will consider when making the decision to divert, such as the weather information and runway conditions about the alternate airport, the fuel endurance, ground services and so on.

items.q: How can pilots avoid going into stall?
items.cn: 飞行员如何避免进入失速
items.a: During flight, we can keep a good control of the aircraft to ensure the aircraft angle of attack is within the critical angleof attack.

items.q: Does your aircraft have the stall warning?
items.cn: 你飞机有失速警报吗
items.a: Yes, our aircraft have the stall warning. If the aircraft stalls during flight, the stall warning system will give us astall warning.

items.q: What can pilots do to prevent aircraft stall?
items.cn: 飞行员能做什么防止飞机失速
items.a: During flight, we can keep a good control of the aircraft to ensure the aircraft angle of attack is within the critical angleof attack.

items.q: Avoid bad weather maintain situational awareness How do pilots recover from stall?
items.cn: 飞行员如何从失速中改出
items.a: If the aircraft stalls during flight, we will reduce the angle of attack. First, we will disconnect autopilot. Second, we will push (forward) the control column or side stick to make the nose down. Third, we will roll the wings level. Fourth, we will add thrust or power. Fifth, we will retract the speedbrakes or spoilers to improve the lift and the stall margin. Sixth, we will return to the flight planned path.

items.q: What are the main factors to cause altitude deviation?
items.cn: 导致飞错高度的主要因素有哪些
items.a: There are some main factors that may cause altitude deviation. First, if we encounter (are caught in) a strong updraft, it may cause altitude deviation. Second, if we encounter altimeter error, it may cause altitude deviation. Third, if we misunderstood the level instruction from ATC, it may cause altitude deviation.

items.q: Seven What should a pilot do to avoid altitude deviation?
items.cn: 为了避免飞错高度，飞行员应该怎么做
items.a: There are many things we can do to avoid altitude deviation. First, we should follow ATC instructions to avoid altitude deviation. If we are unsure about the ATC instructions, we should confirm with ATC immediately. Second, we can cross check each other to avoid altitude deviation.

items.q: What should a pilot do to avoid level deviation?
items.cn: 飞行员应该怎么做避免飞错高度
items.a: There are many things we can do to avoid level deviation. First, we should follow ATC instructions to avoid level deviation. If we are unsure about the ATC instructions, we should confirm with ATC immediately. Second, we can cross check each other to avoid level deviation.

items.q: Have you ever received terrain alerts from ATC or terrain radar during flight?
items.cn: 在飞行中，你曾经收到来自管制或地形雷达的地形警告吗
items.a: No, I have never received terrain alerts from ATC or terrain radar during flight.

items.q: I fly da42 which is not equipped with terrain radar What useful information can you get from terrain radar?
items.cn: 你能从地形雷达获取哪些有用信息
items.a: We can get some useful information from terrain radar such as the terrain tracking information and terrain avoidance guidance. If we are too low to the surroundingterrain,we can hear "too low, terrain; too low, terrain", "terrain, pull up; terrain pull up"and so on.

items.q: If ATC request the pilot to check the altitude immediately, what will he or she do?
items.cn: 如果管制要求飞行员立即核实高度，他该怎么做？
items.a: If ATC requested us to check the altitude immediately, we would follow the ATC instructions to check the altitudeofour aircraft and confirm we have enough separation with the surrounding terrain.

items.q: If you hear "too low terrain, too low terrain" aural alerts, what is the best way to perform terrain avoidance?
items.cn: 如果你听见“太低，地形；太低，地形”声音警告，避让地 形的最好办法是什么
items.a: If we hear "too low terrain, too low terrain" aural alerts, we will follow GPWS instructions to pull up the aircraft toavoid the terrain.

items.q: If you are in daylight VMC, how will you avoid the terrain?
items.cn: 如果你处于白天 VMC，你如何避开地形
items.a: If we are in daylight VMC, we will follow the GPWS instructions to avoid the terrain. Besides, we can request radar vector to avoid the terrain.
