items.q: Have you ever encountered near air miss?
items.cn: 你遭遇过危险接近吗
items.a: I have never encountered near air miss. But I know, near air miss means that two aircraft are too close to each other, it may trigger TCAS warning or it may even cause mid-air collision.

items.q: For example, if the controller lost situational awareness and issuedwrong instructions to pilots, or the pilots misunderstood the ATC instructions, it may cause near miss. What can pilots do to avoid near miss?
items.cn: 飞行员怎么做才能避免危险接近
items.a: There are many things we can do to avoid near air miss. First, we can follow ATC instruction to maintain enough separation with other aircraft. Second, we can follow TCAS RA to avoid near air miss. Third, if ATC instruction goes against TCAS RA, we should follow TCAS RA to keep enough vertical separationwiththe conflicting traffic.

items.q: Have you ever heard mid-air collision?
items.cn: 你听说过空中相撞吗
items.a: Yes, I have heard some mid-air collision. For example, once a passenger flight collided with a cargo flight over Germany because one aircraft followed ATC instructions and the other aircraft followed TCAS RA.

items.q: What are the possible reasons for mid-air collision?
items.cn: 哪些原因可能导致空中相撞
items.a: There are some possible reasons for mid-air collision. 1) TCAS failure or radar failure may cause mid-air collision. 2) low visbiliry may cause mid-air collision. 3) misunderstanding between pilots and controllers may cause mid-air collision.

items.q: How can pilots avoid mid-air collision?
items.cn: 飞行员如何防止空中相撞
items.a: There are many things we can do to avoid mid-air collision. 1) we can follow ATC instructions to avoid mid-air collision. 2) we can follow TCAS RA to avoid mid-air collision. 3) If ATC instructions conflict with TCAS RA, we should follow TCAS RA.

items.q: Nowadays, the terminal airspace is becoming more and more crowded, do you think there are some potential risks?
items.cn: 现在，终端空域越来越繁忙，有没有什么潜在的风险
items.a: Yes, there are some potential risks. First, it may cause TCAS warning or air miss. Second, it may cause mid-air collision.

items.q: Pilots What are the duties of the pilots on a passenger plane?
items.cn: 客航飞行员的职责有哪些
items.a: As pilots of passenger flight, we are responsible for the safety of the flight. including the safety of the aircraft, the safety of persons on board and their belongings.

items.q: How do you cooperate with your captain or first officer during an emergency?
items.cn: 在紧急情况下，你如何和机长或副驾协作
items.a: In an emergency, the pilots will work as a team and keep good communication and cooperation to ensure the flight safety. The pilot flying will take the control of the aircraft. The pilot monitoring will read out the checklist andmonitorthe aircraft.

items.q: Cabin Crew Are you familiar with the job of cabin crew?
items.cn: 你熟悉空乘的工作吗
items.a: Yes. We are familiar with cabin crew's job. during flight, they will have safety check before the passengers board the aircraft. they will have regular cabin check and offer cabin services to passengers. In emergency situations, the cabin crew will report the situation to captain and help to calm down the passengers.

items.q: How could cabin crew provide support to pilots in emergency situations?
items.cn: 机组人员如何在紧急情况下为飞行员提供支持
items.a: In emergency situations, the cabin crew can provide some support to pilots. First, the cabin crew can report the emergency situation to captain. Second, the cabin crew can calm down the passengers. During emergency evacuation, the cabin crew can lead the passengers to leave the aircraft as soon as possible.

items.q: In your opinion, how can you improve the relationship between flight crew and cabin crew?
items.cn: 你认为，你可以如何提高飞行人员与空乘人员之间的关系
items.a: There are many things we can do to improve the relationship between flight crew and cabin crew. First, we will know the duties and responsibilities of each crew member. Second, we will keep good communication and cooperation with each other.

items.q: Do you think it is necessary for pilots to be familiar with the job of flight attendants?
items.cn: 你认为飞行员有必要熟悉空乘的工作吗
items.a: Yes, I am familiar with cabin crew's work. Cabin crew does many things to help us to complete the flight and ensure flight safety. before flight, the cabin crew will have safety briefing with pilots. Then, they will have safety check before the passengers board the aircraft. During flight, they will have regular cabin check and offer cabin services to passengers. In emergency situations, the cabin crew will report the situation to captain and help to calm down the passengers.

items.q: How can flight crew work together with cabin crew to ensure flight safety?
items.cn: 飞行机组如何与客舱机组配合保证飞行安全？
items.a: We can do many things to work with cabin crew to ensure flight safety. First, in the briefing room, we will know the duties of each other. Second, during flight, we will work as a team and keep good communication and cooperation with cabin crew.

items.q: Passengers If there is a drunk passenger or an unruly passenger on board If there is a drunk passenger quarreling with flight attendant, Forty your aircraft, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果飞机上有喝醉酒的乘客或不守规矩的乘客，你会怎么 做
items.a: I will ask the purser and air marshal to calm down the passenger and keep him under control.

items.q: If there is a fight among passengers in the cabin, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果客舱内乘客打架，你会怎么做
items.a: I will ask the cabin crew to communicate with them to stop fight.If they don't listen and keep fighting. I will askair marshal to rest rain them. After landing, request airport police to take them away.

items.q: If the passenger refuses to turn off his cell phone during flight, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果乘客在飞行中拒绝关闭手机，你会怎么做
items.a: If the passenger refuses to turn off the cell phone,I will tell the flight attendants inform the passenger that it may affect the flight safety. For example, the passenger will be informed that it may affect the radio communication between the pilots and controllers.

items.q: If the passenger refuses to checkin the oversized luggage at the gate, what will you do?
items.cn: 旅客在登机口拒绝托运超大行李，你怎么办？
items.a: If the passenger refuses to check in over-sized baggage at the gate, I will ask the purser to deal with it. We can inform the passengers of the dangers of carrying the over-sized baggage into the cabin. For example, we can tell the passenger that over-sized baggage may cause damage to the aircraft or cause injury to persons on board, it may affect flight safety.

items.q: What topics do you often discuss in CRM training?
items.cn: 在 CRM 培训中，你经常讨论什么话题
items.a: There are many/some topics we often discuss during CRM training such as - how to work as a team, - how to keep good communication and cooperation with each other, - how to improve our situation awareness, - how to reduce human errors and so on.

items.q: Does your airline provide joint CRM training for flight crew and cabin crew?
items.cn: 你的公司提供飞行员和空乘之间的联合 CRM 培训吗
items.a: Yes, our airline often provides joint CRM training for flight crew and cabin crew such as emergency evacuation, flight crew incapacitation and so on.

items.q: Who else do you think should be included in the joint CRM training?
items.cn: 你认为还有谁应该包括在联合 CRM 培训中
items.a: I think many kinds of people should be included in joint CRM training such as flight crew, cabin crew, ground staff, ATC, passengers and so on.

items.q: Have you ever taken CRM training? How often?
items.cn: 你参加过 CRM 培训吗？多久一次？
items.a: Yes, I have ever taken CRM training. We often have CRM training once a year.

items.q: Do you think good cooperation between captain and first officer can benefit flight safety?
items.cn: 你认为机长和副驾驶之间的良好合作有利于飞行安全吗
items.a: Yes, I think good cooperation between captain and first officer can benefit the flight safety because good cooperation can increase our situation awareness, reduce our workload, reduce the humanerrorsand ensure the flight safety. Poor cooperation may cause accidents or incidents.

items.q: In your opinion, what could a captain do to ensure the whole crew work as a team?
items.cn: 你认为，机长可以做什么来确保全体机组成员团队协作
items.a: As a captain, we can do many things to have our crew work as a team. First, we will know/discuss the duties and responsibility in the preflight briefing in the briefing room. Second, we should keep good communication and cooperation during flight to ensure the flight safety.

items.q: What have you learned from your flight instructor?
items.cn: 你从飞行教员那里学到了什么
items.a: I have learned many things from my flight instructor. First, I have learned many flight skills from my flight instructor. Second, I have learned how to be a responsibleman.

items.q: Can you describe your first solo flight?
items.cn: 你能描述下你的第一次单飞吗
items.a: My first solo was exciting and successful. That was a sunny day. The visibility was good, Wind was calm. It wasgoodfor flying. I flew two traffic patterns and made a successful landing.

items.q: How was your first solo flight?
items.cn: 你的第一次单飞如何
items.a: My first solo was exciting and successful. That was a sunny day. The visibility was good, Wind was calm. It wasgoodfor flying. I flew two traffic patterns and made a successful landing.

items.q: What have you learned from your first solo flight?
items.cn: 第一次单飞你学到到了什么
items.a: We have learned many things from my first solo flight. First, we should make good preflight preparation to make flight easier and safer. Second, we should follow the checklist and follow SOP to ensure flight safety.

items.q: How many hours have you had in the simulators?
items.cn: 你模拟机飞了多少小时
items.a: I have had about 40 hours in the simulators.

items.q: Why do pilots need simulator training?
items.cn: 飞行员为什么需要模拟机训练？
items.a: Simulator training is necessary for pilots. In the simulator, we can practice many abnormal situations or emergency situations and how to handle it. It can help to improve our flight skills and flight experience.

items.q: Two What subjects can you practice in the simulator?
items.cn: 你可以在模拟机上练习哪些科目
items.a: We can practice many subjects in the simulator such as engine failure, engine fire, hydraulic failure, electrical failure, flapless landing and so on.

items.q: If yes, how do you deal with the situation in the simulator?
items.cn: 如果是，你在模拟机中如何处置该情况？
items.a: No, we don't have any training related to hydraulic system failure because there is no hydraulic systemin C172.

items.q: Where did you have your recurrent training?
items.cn: 你在哪里进行复训
items.a: We often have recurrent training in our company flight training center.

items.q: What subjects can you review in the recurrent training?
items.cn: 复训可以复习哪些科目
items.a: In recurrent training, we can review many emergency situations and emergency procedures such as hydraulic failure, engine failure, depressurization and so on.

items.q: Which subject do you think is most difficult to handle in recurrent training?
items.cn: 你认为复训中哪个科目最难处理
items.a: I think total hydraulic failure is most difficult to handle in the recurrent training because if there is total hydraulic failure, the aircraft will lose control and it's difficult to resume control.

items.q: Why do we need recurrent training?
items.cn: 为什么我们需要复训
items.a: We need recurrent training because we can review some emergency situations and emergency procedures suchas hydraulic failure, engine failure, depressurization and so on to improve our flight skills.

topics.name: Medical Emergency 医疗紧急情况

items.q: Medical Emergency What kind of medical services can cabin crew provide to passengers on board?
items.cn: 空乘可以给机上乘客提供哪些医疗服务
items.a: Cabin crew can provide some medical services to passengers on board. First, cabin crew can provide first aid to passengers on board. Second, cabin crew can provide some oxygen and some medicine. Third, cabin crew can provide CPR procedures （mouth to mouth services/ Artificial respiration）.

items.q: If one passenger on board suffer from heart attack during flight, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果机上一名乘客飞行中心脏病发，你会怎么做
items.a: If one passenger suffered from heart attack, first, we will ask the flight attendants provide first aid to him. Second, we will make a PA to find a doctor on board. Third, we will report our situation to ATC and request land at nearest suitable airport and medical services.

items.q: If the captain gets/becomes incapacitated during flight, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果飞行中机长失能，你会怎么做
items.a: If the captain gets incapacitated, first, I will take the control of the aircraft and take on his duties. Second, I will inform the cabin crew to offer first aid to him. Forty-three Third, I will report the situation to ATC and request priority landing (diversion to the nearest suitable airport) and medical services.

items.q: Under what circumstances, will pilots declare medical emergency?
items.cn: 什么情况下飞行员将宣告医疗紧急情况
items.a: There are many conditions/situations (in which) we will declare medical emergency. First, if the pilot gets incapacitated, we will declare medical emergency. Second, if the passenger gets seriously ill such as heart attack, we will declare medical emergency. Third, if the passengers get seriously injured, we will declare medical emergency.

items.q: What are the possible reasons for flight crew incapacitation?
items.cn: 机组失能可能的原因有哪些
items.a: There are many possible reasons for crew incapacitation. First, depressurization may cause crew incapacitation. Second, if the pilots get seriously ill or seriously injured, it may cause crew incapacitation. Third, smoke or fire in the cockpit may cause crew incapacitation.

items.q: In your opinion, what can pilots do to minimize the risks of crew incapacitation during flight?
items.cn: 你认为飞行员可以做什么避免机 组失能的风险
items.a: There are many things we can do to avoid crew incapacitation. First, we can do more sports to keep healthy. Second, we can have regular medical check. Third, if there is depressurization or smoke in the cockpit, we should put on the oxygen masks.

items.q: If one crew member loses consciousness during flight, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果一名机组人员飞行中失去意识你会怎么做
items.a: If one crew member loses consciousness during flight, first, I will take the control of the aircraft. Second, I will inform the purser to offer first-aid to him. Third, I will report the situation to ATC and request divert to the nearest suitable airport and medical assistance upon arrival.

items.q: When and where do you need to listen to ATIS broadcast?
items.cn: 你什么时候在哪里有必要收听通波播报
items.a: Before startup and before approach, we need to monitor the ATIS frequency to listen to ATIS.

items.q: What information is included in ATIS?
items.cn: 通波里包括哪些信息
items.a: We can get some important information from ATIS, such as runway in use, types of approach, wind information, cloud information, temperature, dew point, QNH, and so on.

items.q: SOP What does SOP stand for?
items.cn: SOP 代表什么
items.a: SOP stands for Standard Operation Procedures. SOP tells the crew members "Who does What and When" SOP includes normal procedures, emergency procedures and aircraft performance.

items.q: What are the main objects of SOP?
items.cn: SOP 的主要目标是什么
items.a: SOPs are designed/used to ensure good communication and cooperation, reduce human errors, reduce our workloadand enhance flight safety.

items.q: What might happen if SOPs are not followed?
items.cn: 如果不执行 SOP，会发生什么
items.a: If we don't follow SOPs, first, it may cause disagreement between crew members in the cockpit. Second, it may reduce the safety margin and increase the risks of accidents.

items.q: What measures does your company take to ensure the compliance with SOPs?
items.cn: 你公司采取了哪些措施保证 SOP 的执行
items.a: My company has taken many measures to ensure the pilots follow SOPs. First, the crew members should review the SOPs periodically (again and again). Second, Company inspector should monitor the crew members if they follow the SOPs strictly during flight.

items.q: What factors and conditions may affect the compliance with SOPs?
items.cn: 哪些因素和情况 会影响 SOP 执行
items.a: There are some factors and conditions that may affect the (strict) compliance with SOPs such as poor SOP awareness, poor communication and cooperation, poor team work, poor airline safety management andso on.

items.q: What training does your company provide to address and improve the compliance with SOPs?
items.cn: 你们公司提供哪些培训宣讲和提高 SOP 的执行
items.a: My company has taken many measures (trainings) to ensure the pilots follow SOPs. First, the crew members should review/read the SOPs periodically (again and again). Second, Company check pilots should monitor the crew members if they follow the SOPs (strictly) during flight.

items.q: Do you think good CRM practices are dependent upon the strict adherence to SOP?
items.cn: 你认为良好的 CRM 习惯取决于严格执行 SOP 吗
items.a: Yes, I think good CRM practices are dependent upon the strict adherence to SOP because good CRM and SOPs are used to keep good communication and cooperation with each other, increase situational awareness, reduce human errors and ensure flight safety.

items.q: HUD Have you ever heard HUD?
items.cn: 你听说过 HUD 吗
items.a: Yes. I have heard HUD. HUD stands for Head-Up Display.

items.q: When do pilots use HUD?
items.cn: 飞行员什么时候使用 HUD
items.a: HUD is often used in low visibility or when we are performing the CAT II ILS operation.

items.q: What kind of trainings should pilots take before using HUD during flight operations?
items.cn: 飞行使用 HUD 前，飞行员应该参加哪些培训
items.a: The pilots should take some training before using HUD during flight such as how to use HUD, low visibility operation, CAT II ILS operation and so on.

items.q: CVR What does CVR stand for?
items.cn: CVR 代表什么
items.a: CVR stands for Cockpit Voice Recorder. It's a part of the black box. If the a/c crashed, the aviation authortity will use CVR to investigate the accident.

items.q: Are all your company's aircraft equipped with CVR?
items.cn: 你公司所有飞机都配备有驾驶舱语音记录器吗
items.a: Yes, according to the regulation, all the Commercial aircraft should be equipped with CVR.

items.q: QAR Do you know QAR?
items.cn: 你了解 QAR 吗
items.a: Yes, I know QAR. QAR stands for Quick Access Recorder. QAR is widely used to monitor aircraft performanceinflight.

items.q: Can you tell us some examples of items in QAR?
items.cn: 你能举例说一些 QAR 内的东西 参数吗
items.a: Yes. QAR is used to monitor and record some important items /about the aircraft performance during flight such as aircraft system conditions, engine parameters, flight control parameters and so on.

items.q: Is your aircraft equipped with TCAS?
items.cn: 你的飞机有配备 TCAS 吗
items.a: I fly DA42, there is no TCAS on board, but it is equipped with ADS-B. It can help us to avoid conflicting traffic, too.

items.q: How does TCAS work?
items.cn: TCAS 是如何工作的？
items.a: TCAS consists of TCAS TA and TCAS RA.

items.q: Why does CFIT occur?
items.cn: 为什么 CFIT 会发生
items.a: There are some factors that may cause CFIT. 1) Bad weather such as heavy rain, turbuence and ice may increase our workload and cause loss of situational awareness, it may cause CFIT. 2) if we are not familiar with the approach chart or if we are mis-reading the approach chart, it may cause CFIT; 3) if we don't use standard words, it may cause misunderstanding, it may cause CFIT. 4) if we are too tired or if we are unsure of our position, it may cause CFIT.

items.q: How can pilots avoid CFIT?
items.cn: 飞行员如何避免 CFIT
items.a: There are many things we can do to avoid CFIT. 1) the aircraft can be equipped with EGPWS or TAWS to avoid CFIT. 2) we should be aware of the approach and landing risks. 3) we can use CDFA to avoid CFIT.

items.q: What are the advantages of CDFA compared with a conventional step down descent when flying non-precision approach?
items.cn: 与非精密进近时，与传统阶梯式下降相比，CDFA 有哪些优势
items.a: There are some advantages of flying CDFA: 1) it can increase the safety margin by using stable approach and standard procedures; 2) it can increase pilots' situational awareness and reduce pilots' workload; 3) it can improve the fuel efficiency by minimizing the low-altitude level flight time; 4) it can reduce the noise level by minimizing the level flight time at high power; 5) it can avoid CFIT (controlled flight into terrain).

items.q: What is RVSM?
items.cn: 什么是 RVSM？
items.a: RVSM is Reduced Vertical Spacing/Separation minimum.

items.q: What is the base level and the top level of RVSM airspace?
items.cn: RVSM 空域的最低高度和最高高度是多少
items.a: The levels of RVSM airspace in China are ranging from 8900m to 12500m (FL290 to FL410). The base level of RVSM airspace is 8900m and the top level of RVSM airspace is 12500m.

items.q: Seven What are the requirements to operate in RVSM airspace?
items.cn: RVSM 空域运行的要求有哪些
items.a: According to the regulation, there are some requirements to operate in RVSM airspace. First, the aircraft should not be allowed to operate in RVSM airspace until (it is) approved by the authority. Second, The aircraft (operated) in RVSM airspace are equipped with two independent altitude measurement systems (altimeters), an altitude alerting system, an automatic altitude control system and a SSR (Mode C/S) transponder with altitude reporting system.

items.q: What equipment is required before entering RVSM airspace?
items.cn: 进入 RVSM 空域前需要哪些设备
items.a: The aircraft (operated) in RVSM airspace are equipped with two independent altitude measurement systems (altimeters), an altitude alerting system, an automatic altitude control system and a SSR (Mode C/S) transponder with altitude reporting system.

items.q: What would you do if your autopilot failed in RVSM airspace?
items.cn: 如果在 RVSM 空域，自动驾驶仪失效，你该怎么办
items.a: If autopilot fails in RVSM airspace, we will report our situation to ATC and tell the controller we are unableRVSMdue equipment and request leave RVSM airspace. Then we will try to resume the operation of autopilot.

items.q: FCTM What does FCTM stand for?
items.cn: FCTM 代表什么
items.a: FCTM stands for Flight Crew Training Manual.

items.q: What information can you get from FCTM?
items.cn: 你可以从 FCTM 中获取哪些信息
items.a: We can get some information from FCTM such as the normal procedures, emergency situations and emergency procedures and so on.

items.q: When do you use FCTM?
items.cn: 你们什么时候使用 FCTM
items.a: We often use FCTM when we are preparing for the flight or when we have simulator training.

items.q: CPDLC What does CPDLC stand for?
items.cn: CPDLC 代表什么
items.a: CPDLC stands for Controller Pilot Data Link Communication.

items.q: When two-way communication failure occurs, how do you operate CPDLC to follow ATC instructions?
items.cn: 如果发生双向无线电通讯失效，你如何操作 CPDLC 执行管 制指令
items.a: When we encounter the two-way radio communication failure during flight, first, we will squawk 7600. Second, we will follow the last ATC instructions. Third, we will use CPDLC to tell the controller that we have two-way communication failure and request revert toCDPLC.

items.q: RNP What is RNP approach?
items.cn: 什么是 RNP 进近
items.a: RNP stands for Required Navigation Performance. There are two types of RNP approaches: RNP approach and RNP AR approach. Both approaches are similar toRNAV approach, however, RNP approach with the use of various sensors and equipment, achieves far greater accuracythrough the use of performance based navigation (PBN) and can therefore be flown to a DA rather than a MDA.

items.q: What are the advantages of RNP approach compared with other types of approach?
items.cn: 与其他进近方式相比，RNP 进近有什么优势？
items.a: There are many advantages of RNP approach compared with other types of approach.

items.q: What is the maximum fuel quantity your aircraft can carry?
items.cn: 你飞机能携带的最大燃油量是多少
items.a: I flyDA42 maximum fuel quantity of my aircraft can carry 60gallons.

items.q: How can pilots determine the endurance in the flight?
items.cn: 飞行中你如何判断飞行的续航能力（endurance)
items.a: We can know/get fuel endurance based on the full fuel and fuel used on the ECAM or EICAS. 2) we can know/get the fuel endurance based on the flight time and the rate of fuel consumption.

items.q: What reasons might cause fuel shortage on board?
items.cn: 哪些原因会造成燃油短缺（fuel shortage)
items.a: There are many reasons might cause fuel shortage on board. First, fuel leak may cause fuel shortage. Second, bad weather such as thunderstorm may cause long delays or diversion and cause fuel shortage. Third, human errors such as wrong calculation of fuel consumption may cause fuel shortage on board, too.

items.q: Please tell me the legal requirement on your aircraft fuel quantity.
items.cn: 请说说对飞机油量的法规要求。
items.a: I fly da42 The maximum fuel quantity is 60 gallons. The fuel quantity required for each flight includes the fuel to the destination airport, the fuel to the alternate airport, the fuel to hold and the fuel reserve.

items.q: How do you refuel the aircraft before each flight?
items.cn: 你如何给飞机加油
items.a: First, we will check our flight plan and check how much fuel we need. Second, we will contact ground staff to refuel the aircraft. Third, during refueling, we will monitor the aircraft. Fourth, after refueling, we will check fuel amount on board.

items.q: What's safety factors should you consider when refueling the aircraft?
items.cn: 加油时我们应该考虑哪些因素
items.a: To dump fuel, 1）we will report our intention to ATC and request fuel dumping instructions, 2) we will fly to the fuel dumping area and commence fuel dumping. 3) When fuel dumping is completed, we will report it to ATC again and request further instructions.

items.q: Nine Under what circumstances, will flight crew need to execute fuel dumping?
items.cn: 在哪些情况下飞行员会执行放油程序
items.a: There are some situations we will dump fuel. First, if the landing weight exceeds the maximum landing weight, we will dump fuel. Second, if we will make an emergency landing such as belly landing, we will dump fuel.

items.q: What support do you need from ATC during fuel dumping?
items.cn: 放油时，你需要管制员提供哪些帮助
items.a: During fuel dumping, ATC will give us fuel dumping instructions and provide radar vector to the fuel dumping area. Besides, ATC will tell other aircraft we are dumping fuel and avoid the fuel dumping area.

items.q: After refueling, how can you know you have correct amount of fuel on board?
items.cn: 加油后，你如何知道飞机上有正确的燃油量
items.a: After refueling, we can check our loading sheet and our fuel panel to know the required fuel quantity andtheactualfuel quantity on board.

items.q: What will you do if you encounter fuel leakage during refueling?
items.cn: 加油时，你发现漏油，你该怎么办
items.a: If we encounter fuel leakage during refueling, we will report the situation to ground staff and stop refueling. Then we will report the situation to mechanics for maintenance check. Of course, we will report the situation to ATC and our company, too.

items.q: What will you do if you encounter fuel leakage during flight?
items.cn: 飞行中发现漏油，你该怎么办
items.a: If we encounter fuel leakage during flight, we will report our situation to ATC and request divert to the nearest suitable airport for priority landing and request emergency service upon arrival.

items.q: Distress call 7700 What factors might be considered when calculating the fuel quantity for each flight?
items.cn: 计算每次飞行需要的燃油时你要考虑哪些因素
items.a: There are many factors we will consider when calculating the fuel quantities for each flight such as weight and balance, weather conditions, altitude and airspeed, possible delays or diversion and so on.

items.q: What's your company's fuel policy?
items.cn: 你公司的燃油政策是什么
items.a: As I know, our company/airline encourages the pilots to save fuel. That is to say, if the pilots save fuel, they can get more/additional money.

items.q: Do you think higher cruising altitude helps pilots to reduce fuel consumption? Why?
items.cn: 你认为在高高度巡航会帮助飞行员减少燃油消耗吗
items.a: I think cruising at higher altitude can reduce fuel consumption. The aircraft at higher altitude will have less drag because the air (density) is thinner at higher altitude, so it can reduce fuel consumption.

items.q: What's the pilots' role of saving fuel?
items.cn: 在节油方面飞行员充当什么角色（role)
items.a: I think pilots play an important role in saving fuel. Pilots can follow the company rules or regulations toflyata higher/better altitude and speed. In this way, the pilots can save fuel.

items.q: What are your opinions about the policy that airlines encourage pilots to save fuel?
items.cn: 你对公司鼓励飞行员节油的政策怎么看
items.a: As I know, the airlines often encourage pilots to save fuel. I think it's good to encourage pilots to save fuel. On the one hand, it can reduce company cost. On the other hand, it is good to our environment/earth.

items.q: What would be the possible consequences of using contaminated fuel?
items.cn: 如果使用污染燃油，会有什么后果
items.a: If contaminated fuel is used, it may cause engine problem such as engine flameout, engine failure and engine vibration. Besides, it may cause damage to the engine.

items.q: What's your company's fuel policy?
items.cn: 你公司的燃油政策是什么
items.a: As I know, the airlines often encourage pilots to save fuel. The pilots who save fuel will be rewarded. That is to say, if the pilots save fuel, they will get more money.

items.q: Under what circumstances, will pilots need to declare fuel emergency?
items.cn: 在哪些情况下飞行员会宣告燃油紧急情况
items.a: According to regulations, if the fuel endurance at 3000ft over destination airport is less than 30 minutes, we will declare fuel emergency.

items.q: Have you ever encountered any abnormal situations during flight?
items.cn: 飞行中遭遇过非正常情况吗
items.a: No, I have never encountered abnormal situations during flight, but I have practiced many abnormal situationsin simulator training and recurrent training such as engine failure, electrical failure and so on.

items.q: Do you have simulator training about emergency situations?
items.cn: 你们有模拟机训练紧急情况吗
items.a: Yes, every year, we will have simulator training about emergency situations such as engine failure, hydraulic failure, communication failure, navigation failure and so on.

items.q: If you note there is smoke or fire in the flight deck, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果你注意到驾驶舱有延烟雾，你将如何处置
items.a: If there is smoke in the cockpit, 1) we will put on the oxygen masks. 2) we will declare distress (make a MAYDAY call) and request emergency descent and divert to the nearest suitable airport and request emergency services such as fire services (fire trucks, fire engines), medical services (ambulance, first aid) 3) we will perform/carry out smoke procedures to find out the source of smoke and remove the smoke.

items.q: What are the possible reasons for smoke in the flight deck?
items.cn: 驾驶舱冒烟的原因有哪些
items.a: There are some possible reasons for smoke in the flight deck. First, electrical fire (short circuit) may cause smoke in the flight deck. Second, pilots smoking in the cockpit may cause smoke in the flight deck. third, smoke in the air conditioning pack may cause smoke in the cockpit.

items.q: During cruising, if the flight attendants observe some smoke in If there is smoke in the cabin, Fifty-one the cabin, what will you do?
items.cn: 如果客舱有烟雾，你将如何处置
items.a: First, we will put on the oxygen masks; second, we will report the situation to ATC and request emergency landing at nearest suitable airports and emergency services. third, the cabin crew will find the source of smoke. fourth, we will make emergency descent and remove the smoke.

items.q: If yes, please say something about it;If no, do you think smoke or fire on board is danger?
items.cn: 你认为机上冒烟起火危险吗？
items.a: No, I have never encountered smoke or fire on board. But I know smoke or fire on board is very dangerous. It maycause structural damage to the aircraft and injuries to persons on board.

items.q: In your opinions, how can pilots increase the safety margin during flight operation?
items.cn: 你认为，飞行员在飞行操作中如何可以提高安全系数
items.a: There are many things we can do to increase the safety margin. 1) we should follow SOP to increase safety margin. 2) we should have good situation awareness to increase safety margin. 3) we should use standard words/callout to increase safety margin. 4) we should develop good flight disciplines to increase the safety margin.

items.q: If you encounter engine fire just after airborne, what will you do next?
items.cn: 刚离地，你遭遇发动机起火，你如何处置
items.a: If we encounter engine fire just after airborne, we will report our situation to ATC and request immediate return for priority landing and emergency services after landing such as fire services and medical services. Then we will use fire extinguishers to put out engine fire. If necessary, we will shut down the faulty engine.

items.q: Tail Strike Have you ever encounter Tail Strike?
items.cn: 你曾经遇到过擦机尾吗
items.a: No, I have never encountered tail strike during flight.

items.q: Tail strike may cause damage to the fuselage and the tail of the aircraft. When is tail strike most likely to occur?
items.cn: 擦机尾什么时候最可能发生
items.a: Tail strike often happen during takeoff and landing. Because during takeoff and landing, the aircraft is going to lift off the ground or touch down on the ground, if wedon't have a good control of the aircraft, the tail will strike the ground.

items.q: What are the possible reasons for tail strike?
items.cn: 可能发生擦机尾的原因有哪些
items.a: There are many possible reasons for tail strike. First, pilot flight skills may cause tail strike. For example, the pilot pulls up the aircraft too much duringtakeoffor landing. Second, strong wind shear, strong crosswind or strong tailwind may cause tail strike. Third, CG problem/weight and balance problem may cause tail strike.

items.q: What are the effective ways to avoid tail strike?
items.cn: 避免擦机尾的有效方法有哪些？
items.a: What can pilots do We can do many things to avoid tail strike.

items.q: Do you know tail strike?
items.cn: 你了解擦机尾吗
items.a: Yes, I know. I heard one tail strike incident. It was occur red in our flying school. One student pilot had a tail strike during landing, because of improper control

items.q: What's your understanding of in-flight equipment malfunction?
items.cn: 你如何理解空中设备故障？
items.a: I have never encountered in flying equipment malfunction, but I know that equipment malfunction is a very serious and dangerous situation.

items.q: A malfunctioning piece of equipment can affect the safety and operation of the entire flight. If your weather radar failed during flight, what would you do?
items.cn: 如果气象雷达飞行中失效，你将怎么做
items.a: If the weather radar fails during flight, we will report the situation to ATC and request the weather information along the route and request radar vector to avoid the weather ahead.

items.q: If the autopilot can't be connected during flight, can you tell us the differences in the cockpit task-sharing?
items.cn: 如果自动驾驶仪飞行中无法接通，你能告诉我们驾驶舱任务 分工的不同吗
items.a: If the autopilot can't be connected during flight, the pilot flying will keep the control of the aircraft, the pilot not flying will monitor the aircraft and complete the emergency checklist to resume autopilot.

items.q: What's the difference between cargo flight and passenger flight?
items.cn: 货运航班和客运航班有什么区别
items.a: As I know, there are some differences between passenger flight and cargo flight. First, the passenger flight transports passengers and their luggage to their destination while cargo flight just transports cargos. Fifty-three Second, in passenger flight, we can fly with flight attendants while we just fly with cargos in cargo flight.

items.q: What are the duties of the pilots on a passenger plane?
items.cn: 在客航上飞行员的职责是什么
items.a: As pilots of passenger flight, we are responsible for the safety of the flight including the safety of the aircraft, the safety of persons on board and their belongings.

items.q: What's the difference between day flight and night flight?
items.cn: 白天飞行和夜间飞行有什么差别
items.a: There are some differences between day flight and night flight. During day flight, we have better visual reference. During night flight, it's difficult to have visual contact with the runway, we have to use ground equipment tohelpusto land safely.

items.q: Does your company have enough international routes?
items.cn: 你公司有足够的国际航线吗
items.a: Yes. I work for Air China. We have not enough international routes.

items.q: Do you prefer to fly domestic routes or international routes?
items.cn: 国内航线与国际航线，你更喜欢哪个
items.a: I prefer international routes. There are many reasons for that. First, I will have more flight experience. Second, I have the chance to travel around the world and enjoy local culture. It's my dream. Third, I can improve my English.

items.q: Do you prefer to fly long-haul routes or short routes?
items.cn: 长航线与短航线，你更喜欢哪个
items.a: I prefer short routes because I will have more flight experience with more takeoffs and landings. Besides, I will have more time to stay with my family.
